jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Mixpanel 
 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team 
 The Revenue Marketing team at Mixpanel is responsible for pipeline generation across paid, organic, and product-led channels. This role sits within that team as its dedicated lifecycle owner, accountable for the programs and systems that turn interest into pipeline and move high-quality leads toward a meeting. 
 We're early in building a true channel team. With that comes real ownership and real influence over how this motion gets built. You won't be inheriting a mature engine, you'll be defining it. 
 About the Role 
 As our Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you own the always-on programs that drive conversion from handraiser to qualified meeting. That means building the nurture infrastructure, establishing best practices, and acting as a strong partner to regional campaign managers who need scalable, repeatable plays they can execute with confidence. 
 This is not a volume game. Our focus is high-quality engagement with the right accounts at the right moment — and you'll be the person who architects that motion end-to-end. 
 You'll work closely with Marketing Operations and Performance Marketing to define how email fits into the broader GTM stack, and you'll be a key stakeholder in how we operationalize HubSpot as our lifecycle layer. Responsibilities  
 
 Own the lifecycle marketing program from lead capture through demo booked nurture sequencing, segmentation logic, and revenue tracking 
 Build and manage always-on email programs in HubSpot, including lead nurture, re-engagement, and handraiser follow-up workflows 
 Partner with Marketing Ops to define system ownership across the GTM stack and establish clear rules of engagement between lifecycle, sales outreach, and product-led touchpoints 
 Collaborate with regional campaign managers to develop scalable, channel-ready lifecycle plays, reducing ad hoc execution and increasing consistency 
 Define and enforce email best practices across the org, including cadence, segmentation, and suppression logic to protect deliverability and audience trust 
 Instrument lifecycle performance in Mixpanel, guide building of  dashboards that track funnel conversion, sequence performance, and influence on pipeline 
 Partner with Performance Marketing on handraiser conversion strategy, aligning paid and lifecycle motions around shared pipeline goals 
 Work with the Marketing Ops team to bring clarity to tool ownership and use cases, particularly across HubSpot and any overlapping systems 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 4+ years in lifecycle, email, or demand gen marketing with clear ownership of a B2B nurture program from strategy through execution 
 Hands-on experience building in HubSpot (or a comparable MAP- Marketo) — segmentation, workflows, sequences, reporting 
 Strong understanding of the handraiser-to-pipeline funnel in a B2B SaaS context, with a track record of improving conversion rates 
 Comfortable navigating a stack that's still being defined — you can assess what's broken, prioritize what matters, and build without waiting for perfect conditions 
 Strong instincts on quality-over-volume lifecycle strategy: you know how to drive engagement without burning your audience 
 Able to partner effectively with both technical (ops, engineering) and non-technical (regional marketers, field) stakeholders 
 Analytical mindset, you measure what you build, and you use data to iterate 
 
 Bonus Points 
 
 Experience building lifecycle programs at a product-led growth company 
 Background in sales-assisted + PLG hybrid motions where lifecycle bridges both 
 Familiarity with Qualified or similar handraiser/chat tools 
 Experience working alongside or standing up a Marketing Ops function from early stages 
 
 #LI-Hybrid Compensation 
 The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here . Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information. Mixpanel Compensation Range $128,500 — $173,500 USD Benefits and Perks 
 
 Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care 
 Mental Wellness Benefit 
 Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays 
 Enhanced Parental Leave 
 Volunteer Time Off 
 Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break 
 
 *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* 
 Culture Values 
 
 Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress. 
 Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes. 
 One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone. 
 Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations. 
 Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star. 
 Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible. 
 
 Why choose Mixpanel? 
 We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

jobs.excerpt:
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Line Haul is looking for a talented Sr. Business Analyst who will own analytics and develop solutions to drive insights and optimization for Network Planning and Forecasting. As a member of this team, you will have an opportunity to be a thought leader in Amazon Logistics and work with a group of talented program managers, product managers, research scientists, software developers, and business leaders to design the Amazon network of the future. As a member of this collaborative team, you will have an opportunity to make an impact in Amazon Logistics and work with a group of talented program managers, product managers, research scientists, software developers, and business stakeholders to design the Amazon network of the future. As a Sr. Business Analyst, you will operate at the crossroads of multiple complex Amazon systems. Specifically, this role will be responsible for owning our most critical efficiency metrics including: Trailer repositioning cost (how much we spend to reposition trailers) and network balance (how balanced is the network). As a business owner you will be expected to produce weekly metrics and callouts, perform deep dives as new products launch that could impact these metrics, contribute to monthly business reviews with VPs, and build models to forecast these metrics for annual/quarterly planning cycles. These metrics are directly used to drive our financial plan, almost all product features in our space are designed to improve these metrics, and they have VP level visibility. This position requires excellent analytical thinking, ability to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply analytics, technical and engineering expertise to rapidly analyze, validate, visualize, prototype and deliver solutions. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Partnerships
jobs.excerpt:
Perplexity is revolutionizing how the world gets work done, and we do it alongside some of the most important companies in the world. We are seeking a PMM focused on Partnerships to formally build that function from the ground up. You will become the face that some of Perplexity's most important partners rely on, and the person who makes our joint moments land.

This is a 0>1 role with executive exposure from day one. It has two sides. You are the relationship owner who partners trust and internal teams turn to, and you are the program manager who keeps every joint launch, event, and campaign on the rails. You'll work directly with teams across comms, product marketing, sales, and product, owning how Perplexity and its partners show up to the world together.

If you learn fast, thrive in ambiguity, and build trust with the biggest companies in the world instinctively, this role is for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own Perplexity's partner marketing function end to end, from joint strategy through campaign execution and reporting

 - Build annual joint marketing plans with our most important partners, with committed pipeline and revenue targets, and run the QBR cadence that keeps both sides accountable to them

 - Ensure Perplexity and our partners are both accountable. Execute, driving joint marketing ideas from concept to shipped and following through so commitments turn into real activity, not slideware

 - Own the joint value proposition and narrative, crafting the "better together" story so it is aligned across both companies, resonates with buyers, and is mutually beneficial

 - Execute full-funnel co-marketing with and through partners, including joint webinars, events, ABM, content syndication, email, and digital campaigns

 - Build partner enablement assets, including co-branded content, solution briefs, pitch decks, joint case studies, and campaign-in-a-box kits, so partner teams can sell and market with us at scale

 - Coordinate launch moments and joint announcements, amplifying Perplexity product launches and major industry moments through the ecosystem

 - Instrument measurement and attribution, tracking partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in CRM, and reporting ecosystem impact to leadership.

 - Align the field, making sure Perplexity sales and Customer Success know about, trust, and activate partner programs so they stick

 - Act as connective tissue between Partnerships and BD, PMM, Demand Generation, Sales, and Comms, and serve as the primary marketing counterpart to our partners' marketing teams

 - Maintain strong relationships in partner organizations and Perplexity across diverse organizations

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years in B2B marketing, preferably in partner, alliance, or ecosystem marketing

 - Proven track record running joint go-to-market with technology and ISV partners, cloud providers, or system integrators, and shipping campaigns that generated real pipeline

 - A closer on accountability, with the operating discipline to build a plan, hold two organizations to it, and drive follow-through when commitments slip

 - Strong storyteller who can craft a joint narrative that is crisp, differentiated, and credible to buyers and executives on both sides

 - Full-funnel campaign operator fluent across webinars, events, ABM, content, and digital, comfortable executing hands-on rather than only directing

 - Analytically rigorous, with experience setting up attribution and reporting partner-sourced and influenced pipeline; comfortable in CRM and revenue operation tools

 - Excellent relationship builder who can be trusted while representing Perplexity's interests to partners

 - Autonomous self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, builds the playbook rather than waiting for one, and operates with urgency in a high-growth environment

You are obsessed with customer success and advocate for our users as much as you work to accelerate their journey on MongoDB Atlas. 
 You have a solid knowledge of the customer journey, including onboarding, adoption, retention, monetization strategies and tactics, and running experiments both in and out of the product. This includes taking initiatives from ideation all the way through execution and continuous iteration. You also have experience in database segmentation and marketing to developers or a highly technical audience to drive early-stage planning all the way through to cross-functional execution. You possess strong communication and collaboration skills. 
 This is a highly visible role that requires a change agent with natural leadership skills and the ability to work across multiple teams with members at different levels.  We’re looking for someone with 
 
 5+ years of B2D or B2B experience in lifecycle and/or growth marketing. Product-led growth experience desired (bonus points for experience/understanding with agent-led growth!) 
 Drive to provide the best possible experience to our customers and users 
 Deep understanding of marketing to developers or a highly technical audience required 
 Expertise in owning end-to-end execution and creating, implementing, and optimizing lifecycle campaigns across the customer journey

 Passion to objectively measure your efforts and only make decisions based on data 
 A collaborative mindset - you love working with others and incorporating relevant feedback

 Proven ability to turn initial ideas into successful, measurable programs that drive tangible results 
 Flexibility and adaptability - you enjoy working in ambiguity. You are calm and effective under pressure and able to pivot quickly. You excel at task prioritization and proper evaluation of situational urgency 
 Focus and drive - you know what matters and apply yourself with gusto, continuously exploring how much faster you can learn and execute 
 Experience or have a working knowledge of product-led growth strategies and KPIs

jobs.excerpt:
About Remote 
 Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. 
   
 If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you 
 
 Own the technical implementation of our Marketing Operations Foundations program - our strategic marketing processes and products that enable how Remote acquires, nurtures, serves, and grows customers. Work with Marketing Ops, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Data, and Legal to translate strategic requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 Be a part of a marketing operations data transformation 
 Define product strategy, architecture, and roadmaps while treating business systems as products rather than standalone tools. 
 Drive technology decisions, including build vs. buy evaluations, AI adoption, and long-term platform evolution. 
 Build and ship GTM products and features using AI tools 
 Partner with stakeholders across Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Business Systems, Data, AI, and Engineering to deliver scalable business capabilities. 
 Shape the future of Remote's Revenue Technology ecosystem by continuously improving the products that power our go-to-market organization. 

 What you bring 
 
 Experience owning the technical implementation of business systems, technology products, or product portfolios within a Marketing Operations environment—ideally with hands-on experience addressing data governance, compliance frameworks, or system integration challenges at scale. 
 Strong understanding of marketing data architecture, integrations, data models, and end-to-end marketing processes, with the ability to identify and articulate interconnected dependencies across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and data platforms. 
 Experience leading or managing complex, multi-month technical initiatives involving cross-functional teams, with proven ability to break down ambiguous problems into executable roadmaps. 
 Hands-on experience with data quality, data retention policies, consent management, or regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA) in a B2B SaaS environment. 
 Ability to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and determine when capabilities should be delivered through configuration, automation, AI, custom development, or third-party technology—with experience executing these decisions in complex, multi-system environments. 
 Excitement for and experience in using AI tools such as Claude Code to build tooling, automation, and processes. 
 Excellent technical communication and stakeholder management skills—ability to translate technical complexity into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and align teams around a shared vision. 
 Experience working with technologies commonly used across GTM, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, LeanData, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Clay, Qualified, APIs, integration platforms, and business intelligence tools. 
 Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities. 
 Writes and speaks fluent English. 
 It's not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Own the vision, roadmap, architecture, and lifecycle for one or more Marketing products/processes and the business capabilities they enable. 
 Prioritize initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and strategic objectives while defining measurable product success metrics. 
 Own the long-term evolution of your product ecosystem, ensuring systems remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business strategy. 
 Evaluate and recommend build, buy and configure AI-driven solutions to deliver new capabilities while simplifying and consolidating the technology landscape. 
 Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable solutions, balancing stakeholder requests with long-term product direction. 
 Own governance, documentation, release planning, adoption, and ongoing product performance.

The right candidate is adept at running a reliable, high-volume execution engine, partnering closely with marketing, product, event, and partner teams , and leveraging AI to continue to scale the channel. This is a terrific opportunity for a sharp marketing operator to make a big impact in a dynamic, fast-moving organization. If this sounds like you, then we'd love to hear from you! 
 What You'll Do 
 
 Own end-to-end execution of global campaigns, ensuring scalable, repeatable program delivery across email, paid search, webinars, events, and ABM. 
 Execute the end-to-end email development pipeline (build, QA, deploy, localize) for all campaigns through the Marketing Automation Platform.

 Manage compliance and database hygiene tasks including GDPR, opt-in management, unsubscribes, invalid/suspended records. 
 
 What You Have 
 
 BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 3+ years of marketing automation, email marketing, or marketing operations experience (Marketo marketing automation platform preferred). 
 Hands-on execution depth in a major marketing automation platform, including segmentation, smart campaigns, dynamic content, and deliverability mechanics.

 Experience supporting Product Marketing, Product, and event teams on tight cycles. 
 Pragmatism around localization, regional differences, and the operational reality of multi-language sends. 
 Strong analytical ability, an evidence-driven approach to measuring/improving the email channel, and a willingness to ask new questions. 
 Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills, excellent cross-functional coordination, and a passion for the email channel. 
 Familiarity with GDPR and email compliance requirements preferred.

jobs.excerpt:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. 
 We're looking for a Demand Generation Associate, Field Programs , to generate pipeline through Webflow's sponsorships, third-party partnerships, and field activations that our Sales and XDR teams can trust. It's a high-impact, high-visibility role with real ownership from day one and room to shape the strategy as you grow into it. 
 About the role: 
 
 Location: Remote-first (United States) 
 Full-time 
 Permanent  
 Exempt 
 The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. 
 
 United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
 
 Zone A: $116,500 - $140,000 
 Zone B: $110,000 - $132,000 
 Zone C: $103,000 - $124,000 

 This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.  
 Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter. 
 
 Application Information: 
 
 Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy 
 
 Reporting to the Director, Demand Generation 
 
 As a Demand Generation Associate, Field Programs , you'll: 
 
 Own the demand gen execution layer for field plays and event activations. Every Webflow event and field play has a set of DG mechanics that determine whether the investment produces a pipeline. You'll own those mechanics end-to-end including outreach sequencing, list management, event follow-up coordination within 48 hours of event close, and post-campaign reporting.  
 Take full lifecycle ownership of Webflow's third-party sponsorship portfolio — vendor evaluation, contract coordination, budget ownership, campaign integration, and post-campaign reporting for programs like Exit Five, MarTech, Morning Brew and others 
 Run the gifting program end-to-end — campaign trigger setup, execution, inventory management, ROI tracking, and program reporting; treat gifting as a campaign tool tied to specific program moments, not a transactional function 
 Serve as the demand gen point of contact for sponsorship and gifting programs — ensuring Sales, XDR, and Field Marketing have a clear, current picture of what is running, what has landed, and what the results show 
 Build, maintain, and iterate on AI-assisted workflows that support this role's core programs — sponsorship research and evaluation, gifting campaign briefs and copy, post-event reporting, and stakeholder updates 
 Deploy AI agents in production workflows with humans in the review loop — designing systems where agents make routing, offer, and content decisions where appropriate, and knowing when a decision requires a human 
 Evolve the role over time from executing against defined programs to proposing and shaping the sponsorship and field activation strategy — owning a point of view on where Webflow should show up and what outcomes those investments should drive 
 Travel up to 15-20% for company and team offsites  
 
 About you: 
 Requirements: 
 
 2-4 years of experience in demand generation, revenue marketing, growth marketing or a similar function at a B2B SaaS company 
 Track record of coordinating cross-functional programs across Sales, SDR/XDR, and marketing with named examples of how you kept stakeholders informed and investments on track 
 Working experience with AI tools in production workflows - has personally built or iterated on AI-assisted sequences, briefs, or reports (not just used ChatGPT as a search tool) 
 Comfort with marketing automation and CRM systems (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce) for campaign setup, tracking, and reporting 
 
 You’ll thrive as a Demand Generation Associate, Field Programs if you: 
 
 Are operationally disciplined - you get things done on time, on brief, and with clean documentation; nothing slips through your queue 
 Think beyond the brief - you don't just execute the program calendar, you notice patterns in what's working and start forming opinions about where Webflow should show up next. 
 Communicate clearly and proactively - Sales, XDR, and Field Marketing teams learn to trust you because they always know what's running, what's landed, and what the results show without having to chase you 
 Treat every investment as measurable - you don't ship a sponsorship, gift send, or event without a defined success metric attached to it and a reporting plan already in place 
 Bring judgment about when to use AI and when not to - you build AI workflows that save time on research, drafting, and reporting, and you know when a human decision is required before a campaign goes live 
 Have vendor and program management instincts - you can evaluate a sponsorship offer against alternatives, negotiate scope, and hold vendors accountable for delivering what was contracted 
 Stay curious and open to growth - demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact. 
 
 Our Core Behaviors: 
 
 Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first. 
 Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act. 
 Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible. 
 Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers. 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company. 
 Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums. 
 Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions. 
 Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired. 
 Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching. 
 Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.  
 Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts. 
 Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

 Remote, together

jobs.excerpt:
Amazon MGM Studios is the home for talent, creating and producing Original films and television series for a global audience. Original series premiere exclusively on Prime Video, which is available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video. Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a Social Marketing Manager to join the team! The Social Marketing Manager sits within a global social marketing team for Amazon MGM Studios. They are responsible for developing and executing smart, inventive and highly creative social marketing campaigns for their assigned titles. They develop the social marketing strategies globally, setting a high-bar for innovation, passion and operational excellence. They are responsible for social strategy, social creative development, social listening analytics, community management and social innovation including AR/VR and paid media social products for their assigned titles. The Social Marketing Manager proactively contributes to the cross-functional marketing team for a subset of Amazon MGM Studios’ slate. Reporting directly into a Head of Prime Video US Brand Social for Amazon MGM Studios, they collaborate across marketing globally, ensuring the highest standards for consistency and quality are maintained to drive viewership and attract new customers to Prime Video. The optimal candidate for this role will have experience in owning social marketing campaigns as well as building deep partnerships with global platform partnerships, thus are able to fluidly shift from analytical discussions to strategy to operational to creative. They serve as one of the key points of contact for the social marketing leader globally, so their strategic judgment, creative acumen, awareness of industry trends and ability to think big and innovate must be strong. Finally, the ideal candidate must thrive operating in a startup environment, where leaders are owners, wear multiple hats, and effortlessly think and act both strategically and tactically - from the development of strategic ideas to execution. jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Clipboard is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to help build and run the systems behind our sales organization.

You'll work across Salesforce, data, automation, and internal tools to help our sales team operate more effectively. That might mean building an automation that eliminates a recurring workflow, investigating a messy data problem, redesigning part of our Salesforce setup, or building a new system from the ground up.

We are a small team with an unusual operating model. Much of our execution runs through AI agents that we direct and quality-check, allowing each analyst to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

This is equal parts builder and operator. You'll own systems end to end, work through ambiguous requests from reps and leadership, and be accountable for making sure the things you build actually work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own live systems. Take ownership of production systems such as account distribution, deal intelligence, competitor tracking, and data sync pipelines. You'll be accountable for their accuracy and reliability.

 - Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.

 - Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.

 - Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.

 - Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.

 - Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.

 - AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.

 - High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.

 - Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.

 - Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.

SQL and Python experience are strong pluses, but we're more interested in your curiosity, judgment, and ability to ship than checking every technical box.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Salesforce administration or development experience, including flows, SOQL, or data model design.

 - Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, analytics, or a similar environment.

 - Experience building automations with tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Application Review – We'll review your experience and evidence of things you've built, automated, or owned.

 2. Take-Home Assessment – A practical, ~2-hour assessment using a fictional company, mock website, and CRM. You'll have 48 hours to complete it, and AI tools are encouraged.

 3. Technical Walkthrough – A 45-minute session where you'll demo what you built, explain your decisions, and make a small live change to your system.

 4. Manager Interview – A 30-minute conversation focused on communication, ownership, judgment, and how you operate under ambiguity.

 5. Final Steps / Offer! – Some candidates may have an executive conversation, followed by references and an offer.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary

 - Insurance benefits + 401k options

 - Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays

 - Remote-first working environment

To get a better understanding of the general type of people we want to hire, you can check out our blog here. https://creatingvalue.substack.com/

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

jobs.title: GTM Systems and Business Process Manager - Renewals and CX
jobs.excerpt:
We're looking for a Business Process Manager to serve as the connective tissue between our Renewals and Customer Success teams and the Enterprise Technology organization. This is a cross-functional, high-visibility role for someone who thrives at the intersection of operations, strategy, and technology — someone who can walk the floor with a CSM in the morning, then translate what they heard into a crisp business requirements document by afternoon. 
 This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements. 
 What you’ll achieve 
 
 Serve as the translation layer between the field and technical teams - embed with Renewals, Customer Success, and adjacent teams to develop a ground-level understanding of how work actually gets done 
 Surface pain points, bottlenecks, and unmet needs through structured discovery: interviews, process shadowing, workflow audits, and data analysis. Translate field insights into clear, actionable business requirements that the Enterprise Technology team can execute against 
 Own the process improvement lifecycle - Map current-state workflows and identify gaps between how tools are used and how they could be used. Prioritize improvement opportunities based on business impact, effort, and strategic alignment 
 Track adoption and outcomes post-launch; close the feedback loop with stakeholders 
 Drive cross-functional alignment - Facilitate working sessions with stakeholders across Renewals, Customer Success, Revenue Strategy & Operations, and Enterprise Technology 
 Serve as the single point of contact for field teams seeking to escalate tool friction or request workflow changes 
 Support the tools ecosystem - Become a power user in the tools used by Renewals and CS teams (Salesforce, QuadSci, and  Trig.ai ). Identify where tooling gaps create manual workarounds or downstream data quality issues 
 Evaluate new tool requests against existing capabilities; build the business case where new investment is warranted 
 
 About you 
 
 7+ years in business operations, revenue operations, process improvement, or a related field; experience supporting customer-facing go-to-market teams strongly preferred 
 Track record of translating ambiguous operational problems into structured requirements and seeing them through to execution 
 Experience working cross-functionally with technical teams (engineering, IT, or enterprise technology); familiarity with agile or product development workflows a plus 
 Exposure to renewals, customer success, or SaaS go-to-market motions preferred 
 Strong understanding of AI CSM tools to drive productivity and efficiency 
 Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can make a complex workflow legible to an engineer and make a technical constraint legible to a CSM 
 Strong process thinking: you naturally ask "why does this work this way?" before asking "how do we fix it?" 
 Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making 
 
 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. 
 What we’ll offer Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit. 
 For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $185,000 - $210,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified. 
 In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role. 
 We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include: 
 
 Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits 
 Career coaching & support 
 Inclusive family building benefits 
 Long-term savings or retirement plans 
 In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences  
 
 These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role. 
 #LI-Hybrid About us 
 Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong. 
 We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 As a Growth Marketing Manager you will: 
 Website Ownership

 AI-Native Ways of Working

 2–3 years of hands-on experience working on a corporate website or web growth program for a SaaS, AI, or tech company.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Privacy and Video Security
jobs.excerpt:
Who We Are 
 Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.  
 We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. 
 You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.  About the Role 
 As the Product Marketing Manager for Privacy and Video Security, you will play a dual role sitting at the intersection of Verkada’s core corporate mission and our flagship product. 
 First, you will be responsible for defining and driving the narrative around Verkada’s approach to privacy and data security. These elements are never afterthoughts at Verkada; they are foundational to how we design our technology and a core differentiator that enables us to earn the trust of – and successfully sell to – some of the world’s largest organizations. In this role, you will lead the charge in proactively establishing Verkada as the undisputed leader in how a cloud-first physical security company should approach privacy and data security. You will go incredibly deep into the weeds of our technical architecture, becoming a subject matter expert who can be strategically deployed to create customer-facing collateral, go toe-to-toe with technical experts and executive buyers, and evangelize our privacy and security posture across the entire go-to-market engine. 
 Second, you will play a critical role in driving the growth of Verkada’s largest product line, Video Security. Working alongside our existing Video Security PMM team, you will co-own the go-to-market strategy and oversee high-profile product launches. Beyond leading launches, you will be integral in translating hardware and software features into the collateral needed to enable our Sales, Demand Generation, and Channel Marketing teams to win. 
 Both halves of this role are deeply cross-functional and require you to bring together stakeholders across the Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Communications teams. You will also partner closely with Verkada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Chief Privacy Officer. 
 We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This position will be based in-person at our HQ in San Mateo, CA. 
 What You'll Do 
 
 Hone Verkada’s privacy and security narrative: Clearly articulate how Verkada differentiates itself, our fundamental approach to data protection, and how these practices deliver value to our customers. Refine and adapt our messaging and positioning strategies in response to product developments, competitor movements, and public sentiment. 
 Drive proactive privacy thought leadership and asset creation: Author, advise on, and elevate high-impact collateral – including technical whitepapers, one-pagers, blogs, videos, and sales decks – to position Verkada as the definitive authority in the space. Take complete ownership of the Verkada Trust Hub webpage, significantly expanding its depth to turn it into a comprehensive, best-in-class destination for public transparency. 
 Execute Video Security product launches: Bring new Video Security products and features to market by developing competitively differentiated messaging and positioning, setting a go-to-market plan, and planning and creating deliverables in order to maximize impact. 
 Serve as a cross-functional subject matter expert: Act as a definitive expert on both Video Security and data privacy across our product portfolio. Unite Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to drive commercial results, lead Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, and directly empower our field organization to navigate complex technical privacy evaluations. 
 Enable the go-to-market engine: Partner closely with Sales, Demand Generation, Creative, and Channel Marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth. Translate complex hardware capabilities and technical privacy frameworks into high-impact outbound marketing assets and field collateral that directly improve win rates. 
 
 What You Bring 
 
 2-4+ years of product marketing or related experience in B2B SaaS or IoT 
 Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences, including highly technical content 
 Extreme curiosity and desire to dive deep into the weeds of all things privacy and enterprise data security. Even if you do not have a technical background, you are excited to spend hours learning the intricacies of Verkada’s architecture so you can feel confident speaking with highly technical buyers 
 Self-directed and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment 
 Experience working cross-functionally with teams including Product, Communications, Sales, Demand Generation, and Creative 
 Bachelor’s degree required 
 
 Employee Benefits 
 Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to: 
 
 Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans 
 Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage 
 Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options 
 Expanded mental health support 
 Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits 
 Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time 
 Professional development stipend 
 Wellness/fitness benefits 
 Healthy lunches provided daily 
 Commuter benefits 
 
 Additional Information 
 
 You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time. 
 Annual Pay Range 
 At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

We transform, improve, and support global Stripe business processes to drive critical initiatives and other cross-functional business priorities for the sales planning cycle.

 Project management: 
 
 Lead and manage day-to-day operations of large-scale transformational projects 
 Develop detailed project plans, set milestones, and ensure program integrity 
 Standardize reporting and systems requirements

 Minimum requirements

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners. When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end. 
 Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches — the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side. 
 You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work. This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners — briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together. You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners. 
 The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you. 
 Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it. 
 Responsibilities 

 Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem — from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting 

 Define the operating model for partner launches: set the standard for what readiness means, decide what's durable enough to share and when, and own the trade-offs when timelines and partner needs conflict 

 Equip partner sellers and solution architects to position Claude for a customer workload without escalating to us — segment-specific enablement, technical content, and the materials their field actually reaches for 

 Translate Anthropic positioning for partner surfaces, taking source messaging from Product Marketing and creating partner-specific versions that account for what's available where, what each partner needs to hear, and how the narrative lands on their platform 

 Own the go-to-market motion for joint and co-built solutions on partner surfaces — position what a partner and Anthropic have built together, make the value legible to that partner's sellers and customers, and land it across the channels where their buyers look 

 Work with Partnerships, Product, and partner-side teams to shape solutions into launchable moments, and make the call on which are worth a launch at all 

 Run launch execution – Manage cross-functional review cycles, support partner launch preparedness, compile post-launch reporting 

 Build post-launch momentum through partner webinars, technical content pipelines, and campaigns that keep partners selling after launch-day 

 Represent the partner perspective internally — surface Anthropic-direct launches that will affect partner relationships, flag partner-experience issues in product decisions, and make sure partner considerations arrive early rather than as a fire drill 

 Turn informal knowledge into documented, repeatable process as our release cadence and partner portfolio grow, and build the function so it scales beyond any one person 

 You may be a good fit if you 

 Have done partner marketing or product marketing work for or on cloud AI/ML platforms — positioning products on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or directly comparable surfaces, whether from inside a cloud provider or as an independent software vendor launching on one 

 Understand how cloud partner organizations actually work — how their sellers are compensated, what makes a partner's field choose to lead with one vendor over another, and how co-sell and marketplace mechanics shape that choice 

 Have written and rewritten positioning yourself, not only coordinated it; can tell what makes messaging land with a technical audience, and can spot the claim that Legal will flag before Legal does 

 Have set direction on programs rather than only executing them — defining how the work gets done and bringing others along, not inheriting a playbook 

 Can drive cross-functional work without direct authority, pushing internal teams and external partner organizations toward deadlines while keeping the relationships intact, in fast-moving environments where dates move and information is incomplete 

 Handle confidential information rigorously, including tiered need-to-know structures and pre-announcement codenames 

 Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial 

 Strong candidates may have 

 A partner enablement background — you have designed and delivered enablement for a partner's sellers or solution architects, not only produced materials for them 

 Have worked directly at AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft, in partner marketing on AI/ML services 

 Have taken joint or co-built solutions to market with a partner — reference architectures, industry solutions, marketplace offerings, or similar 

 Can position both a product and a solution — the launch of a new capability and the story of what customers build with it — and know that the two are different jobs 

 Have built a launch function or launch process from scratch, not only run an existing one 

 Background in competitive intelligence or competitive messaging 

 Experience marketing to developers or other technical audiences 

 Familiarity with cloud marketplace listings and the enterprise procurement motion

Who We Are 
 Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.  
 We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. 
 You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.  About the Role 
 We’re looking for a dynamic, strategic marketer to lead the charge across our Channel Technical Programs—including Technical Training & Certification, the Premier Services Network, Partner Community, Demo Program, and more. In this high-impact role, you’ll be responsible for driving growth and engagement for the technical programs that empower our most strategic partners across global markets. 
 As a key player on our team, you’ll define go-to-market strategies, set growth targets, and operationalize marketing efforts to scale. With a focus on demand generation and launching new initiatives, you’ll help accelerate one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. 
 This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves. If you’re technically savvy, passionate about partner and customer success, and excited by the opportunity to shape high-impact programs from the ground up—we’d love to hear from you. 
 What You'll Do

 Brand & Positioning: Build and amplify the brand identity of Verkada’s partner technical programs, ensuring consistent messaging and positioning across all partner-facing touchpoints and digital channels.

 Integrated Campaign Management: Oversee end-to-end campaign development, execution, and optimization across multiple platforms (email, social, paid media, events). Continuously test and iterate to improve ROI and partner engagement.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Go To Market
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 You'll join Stripe's Sales Strategy and Operations team, a high-impact group that helps our GTM organization execute with speed, focus, and rigor. We translate strategy into scalable operating motions across the Americas Sales org and Global Product Sales organizations, including repeatable plays, durable cadences, and clear operational performance management. A core part of our remit is supporting Stripe's Alliances and Channels organization, particularly platform partners and SIs and consultancies. We partner closely with Sales leadership, Marketing, Product, Enablement, RevOps, and Finance to remove friction, improve visibility, and drive consistent execution that accelerates growth. 
 What you'll do 
 As the Go-to-Market Program Manager, you'll design and drive programs that help Stripe's Sales, Partner, and Channel teams execute with clarity and consistency. You'll own end-to-end delivery for critical GTM initiatives—translating strategy into scalable plays, field-ready rollouts, and durable operating cadences. You'll work closely with Sales leadership, Partner teams, Marketing, Product, Sales Enablement, RevOps, and Finance to remove friction from the selling motion, improve pipeline discipline and forecasting rigor, and accelerate partner-influenced growth. In this role, you'll create clarity while navigating ambiguity, and you'll solve complex problems while operating in a high-growth environment. 
 Responsibilities 
 • Strategy and execution—Be accountable for building and driving large-scale GTM programs end-to-end—aligning stakeholders, defining the plan and operating model, and ensuring measurable outcomes. Drive the "full-stack" of change management (stakeholder engagement, champions, communications, and enablement) so programs land successfully with Sales and Partners. 
 • Pipeline hygiene and forecasting cadence—Support operating rhythms that improve pipeline quality, stage discipline, and forecast consistency. Partner with Sales Operations and Sales leadership to drive adoption, surface risk, and ensure leaders have reliable visibility into performance drivers. 
 • Global initiatives—Provide central project management support on high-priority global initiatives (i.e. "Big Rocks" workstreams) to drive decision-making, action, visibility, accountability, and impact. 
 • Partner and channel GTM—Support partner-inclusive motions that embed partners into the selling process (from opportunity identification through close and expansion). Coordinate partner readiness (offers, positioning, assets, and co-selling rhythms) and enable the "operating handshake" across teams to reduce friction and increase speed. 
 • Executive reporting and business reviews—Build concise exec-ready readouts that connect program activity to outcomes (pipeline created, conversion, win rate, cycle time, and partner influence) and drive decisions in WBR, MBR, and QBR forums. 
 • Program scalability and foundation—Develop a roadmap for the foundational requirements to operate the program efficiently and at scale. Drive scalability through process refinement and automation, collaborating closely with critical cross-functional teams to build the needed tools, dashboards, and automation. 
 • Stakeholder alignment and communication—Set goals and targets for programs, run key forums and updates, and keep executives and cross-functional partners informed on progress, risks, and decisions. Build strong collaborative relationships across Stripe. 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 • 4+ years of experience in program management, GTM strategy and operations, business operations, management consulting, or a related discipline 
 • A strong track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs in a changing, ambiguous environment end-to-end (from problem definition through rollout and adoption) 
 • Deep problem-solving and analysis experience (solving business problems—commercial, operational, financial) in a Sales-oriented environment. You must have the ability to diagnose, simplify, and structure problems and solutions while having command of "the details". 
 • Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication experience, influencing across all levels from front lines to C-Suite. You set a high-bar in terms of communication effectiveness.

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. We work globally, on the full customer lifecycle, and with all company segments - from startups to the largest enterprises. This role is focused on driving growth for Stripe Capital. 
 Stripe Capital provides access to fast, flexible financing to businesses, with the mission of helping them accelerate their growth. Businesses use the funds for marketing, hiring, geographic expansion, working capital, new equipment purchases, and much more. Capital has scaled meaningfully over the last few years, both in terms of user impact (over 81,000 businesses received financing through Stripe Capital in 2025 alone) as well as financial impact as a business line within Stripe. Over 95% of our users say they love using Capital, making us one of the most popular products at Stripe—and we're just getting started. 
 What you’ll do 
 As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will be a key driver of global marketing efforts supporting our self-serve user acquisition motions to drive demand and revenue growth for Capital — designing, implementing, and optimizing scaled, global lifecycle campaigns across user segments and life stages. You will help create uncommonly great email marketing campaigns and multi-channel experiences for Capital through a relentless focus on user experience and channel optimization. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Drive ideation, strategy, and execution of scaled lifecycle campaigns across email and in-product notifications to drive core business outcomes (e.g. new user acquisition, product activation, revenue), and test into and scale new channels (direct mail, push notifications, etc)  
 Identify customer needs, ideate solutions to improve user experience, and generate ongoing user-driven insights to inform campaign strategy and optimization 
 Leverage marketing automation, behavioral data, and ML-based techniques to create personalized experiences at scale

 Collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Growth, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 7+ years of work experience in a marketing role designing and launching multi-channel campaigns 
 5+ years of experience analyzing and taking action on the performance of marketing campaigns 
 5+ years of experience writing marketing briefs 
 3+ years of experience leveraging data, AI, and ML-driven techniques 
 3+ years of B2B marketing experience 
 3+ years of email marketing, direct mail, and push notification experience 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience with Marketo, Salesforce, and/or Salesloft 
 Experience working in fintech on lending products

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 
 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 
 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager on our Marketing Operations team to own lead management and revenue handoff — the routing logic and BDR tooling workflows leads and contacts move through, and the rules that determine how and when marketing hands them to sales. 
 This role owns the scoring and routing logic that runs on our core marketing and sales platforms, plus a set of adjacent lifecycle processes — MQL definitions, SLA design, lead source governance, ABM list management, and partner-sourced lead triage. You'll partner with our Sr. Marketing Operations & Technology Manager, who owns core platform administration, and with Sales/BDR leadership on the day-to-day handoff relationship. 
 This is a full-time, fully remote position based in Costa Rica, with working hours aligned to the Central Time zone to support close, real-time collaboration with our Oakland, CA-based team and US sales organization. 
 Technologies You’ll Use 
 
 Marketo, LeanData, Salesforce, Outreach, Nooks, Clay, etc. 
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Scoring & Routing 
 
 Build, maintain, and calibrate the lead scoring model in Marketo, using BDR feedback and closed-won/lost data to keep it predictive rather than stale 
 Own lead routing logic and governance in LeanData — match rules, ownership logic, and routing paths — in partnership with the Sr. Marketing Operations & Technology Manager on platform administration 
 Own MQL definitions and the marketing-to-sales handoff process, including SLA design and ongoing SLA monitoring 
 
 Lifecycle & Handoff Processes 
 
 Own lead/contact lifecycle status management and lead source governance 
 Own inbound and partner-sourced lead triage/routing processes 
 Manage ABM account list and signal strategy in partnership with enterprise sales stakeholders 
 Optimize BDR tooling workflows across Outreach, Nooks, and Clay — sequence/cadence logic, data flow between tools, and adoption — within the platform and vendor decisions set by Systems and leadership 
 Set and enforce SFDC data entry standards for sales-owned fields relevant to lead/contact records, in partnership with Sales leadership 
 Run a regular Sales & MOps alignment cadence with sales/BDR leadership to review routing and handoff health 
 
 Skills We’re Looking For 
 
 4–6 years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or lifecycle roles in B2B SaaS or high-growth environments 
 Direct, hands-on experience building and calibrating lead scoring models in Marketo 
 Experience owning lead routing logic in LeanData or a comparable platform 
 Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to validate routing and scoring outcomes against CRM data 
 Experience partnering with sales or BDR leadership on lead handoff logic, SLAs, routing rules, and CRM data standards 
 Comfortable working independently across US business hours as part of a distributed team 
 Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, or internal tools) to support researching, documenting, and troubleshooting scoring and routing logic, and to synthesize funnel/handoff diagnostics 
 
 (Optional )Bonus Skills​ 
 
 Experience working within BDR-facing tools (Outreach, Nooks, Clay, or comparable) to improve workflow efficiency 
 Experience with Bizible/Marketo Measure, Demandbase, or other ABM platforms 
 Prior experience mentoring or supporting more junior marketing operations team members 
 Experience setting or enforcing CRM data governance standards for a sales organization

 100% employer-paid medical insurance *

 Professional development and training opportunities 
 Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are  
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 
 . See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as our next Marketing Analyst, PLG & Self-Serve Analytics. 
 About the job 
 This position is needed to be part of a highly visible Marketing Analytics team serving as the dedicated analytics partner for Twilio's self-serve and PLG motion, reporting into the MSA&I function (Marketing Strategy, Analytics and Innovation). You will serve as the connective tissue between GTM engineers and business teams , ensuring business goals are translated into scalable technical programs. You will own the end-to-end process of designing and iterating on high-impact sales programs and growth experiments, working with great minds across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Finance. 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Lead PLG Analytics: Own PLG analytics for Twilio's self-service business, including free-to-paid conversion, usage-based cohorting, signal-based audience development, and growth experimentation across the self-serve funnel. Build the bridge between Self Service and GTM motion to allow faster conversions 
 Bridge the Technical Gap: Translate business needs into technical solutions using Python and SQL.  Collaborate with Marketing Data Engineering to take tests from pilot to production. Ensure every technical pilot/ prod development has marketing impact and is measurable and scalable 
 Build Strategic Partnerships: Build relationships with sales and marketing leaders to translate hypotheses into actionable experiments and identify high-leverage use cases 
 Drive Iteration: Build tight feedback loops with sales teams to validate play effectiveness and evolve dashboards, cohort models, and experimentation frameworks 
 Synthesize Data: Distill complex insights into clear, concise communication for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, focusing on 1-2 succinct takeaways for executives. 
 Develop Toolkits: Build and maintain analytical toolkits - scoring models, segmentation frameworks, dashboards - that help Sales and Marketing teams act on insights at scale 
 
 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! 
 *Required: 
 
 Proven Technical Ability: Fluency in SQL and Python is essential. 
 PLG/Self-Serve Experience : Prior experience with product-led growth metrics (activation rates, free-to-paid conversion, usage-based expansion) or experience in a usage-based SaaS environment 
 AI/LLM Fluency: Ability to work with different Large Language Models (LLMs) to develop innovative business solutions. 
 Analytical Mindset: Experience leveraging data to uncover insights and influence business strategy. 
 Strategic Thinker: A passion for "picking up the trash", identifying problems and fixing them proactively instead of waiting for instructions. 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 Location 
 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. 
 Travel  
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.  
 What We Offer 
 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. 
 Compensation

 This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. 
 
 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
