jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. 
 
 About the Brand & Communications team Brand and Communications shapes how the world sees Affirm, and how Affirm chooses to be seen. That means showing up where perception takes shape: in culture and press, across Affirm's owned and paid channels, and within the company. We hold a high standard for craft and clarity, and we work to make Affirm a brand people understand, trust, and are proud to choose. About the Role We're looking for a Brand Manager to turn business priorities and consumer insight into campaigns that shift perception and drive measurable demand. You’ll own campaign strategy from brief through launch and retros, aligning partners, sharpening priorities, and ensuring every expression builds a more distinctive, trusted and effective Affirm brand. 
 What You’ll Do 

 Own campaign strategy and architecture for priority brand and partner moments, including co-marketing projects with key merchants and ongoing merchant and promotional campaigns outside the major seasonal moments. Translate business goals, audience insight, and brand strategy into briefs and recommendations that shape how Affirm invests in these moments, not just how individual campaigns execute. 

 Drive early strategic thinking and lead brief development for partner campaigns, shaping how Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Creative, Social, Paid, and Comms work together on audience, narrative, channel roles, and definition of success. Advise these teams on tradeoffs and complex calls, and review creative to ensure execution teams have what they need to build and ship excellent work. 

 Set campaign GTM strategy and investment priorities across brand and partner moments, determining how Brand Operations resources timelines and workflow and how channel leads allocate budget. 

 Build a learning culture. Define what's working across campaigns and turn it into reusable frameworks and standards that make every future effort stronger. 

 Own brand measurement and reporting in partnership with paid and analyst functions, both for brand overall and campaign by campaign. Maintain the integrity of the brand health tracker, hold execution partners accountable to the brief, and give leadership a clear, recurring read on what's working and what needs to change. 

 What We Look For 

 You have 8-10 years in brand marketing, integrated marketing, or a closely related discipline, with experience managing full campaigns from strategy to launch, ideally at both an agency and in-house teams. 

 As a natural creative thinker and problem solver yourself, you know how to partner and get strong creative out of a team. You've briefed and run creative work that landed sharp, on strategy, on budget and on time. 

 You have a track record of building brand awareness, equity, and differentiation through data and consumer insight, and can evaluate performance against business KPIs. 

 You're comfortable operating in a complex, matrixed marketing organization, and you’re capable of  building alignment across cross-functional partners through influence. 

 You use data to develop and articulate a clear point of view, while staying collaborative and open to new information changing your mind. 

 Bonus. Experience with extending campaigns to global markets, and working in fintech, financial services, or another trust-sensitive category is a plus. 

 Pay Grade - L Equity Grade - 6 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000 
 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. #LI-Remote  

 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities. 
 We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:  
 
 Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents  
 Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses 
 Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge 
 ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount 
 
 We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 Anthropic is hiring a Field Marketing Manager dedicated to the Public Sector Industry — one of the fastest-growing customer segments we serve, and one we believe will define how the next generation of AI-native companies adopts and builds with Claude. You will own the field marketing strategy and end-to-end execution for Public Sector audiences in the US, partnering closely with our Public Sector Sales teams. 
 This is a builder role. Field Marketing at Anthropic is a small, scrappy team and the Public Sector is an area of growth for the business — there is no existing playbook for you to inherit. You will design the event calendar, build the integrated digital programs, develop the necessary partnerships, and create the playbooks that scale across our Public Sector motion. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Develop and activate the US Public Sector field marketing strategy end-to-end — planning, calendar, execution, and measurement. 
 Design and run public-sector-appropriate event formats — agency roundtables, mission-focused briefings, tech demo days, industry days, and executive breakfasts — that comply with government ethics and gift rules while building trusted relationships with program and procurement stakeholders 
 Plan the field calendar around the government fiscal year — building demand programs that peak ahead of federal year-end (September 30) and state budget cycles, and capitalize on use-it-or-lose-it spending windows 
 Own presence at anchor public sector events — from sponsorship strategy to speaker placement and on-site execution 
 Build co-marketing programs with the public sector channel ecosystem — distributors, resellers, systems integrators, and contract-vehicle holders — including joint events, teaming-oriented content, and partner-sourced pipeline 
 Partner closely with Public Sector Sales and BDRs on pre-event targeting, during-event engagement, and post-event follow-up to convert attention into pipeline 
 Build operational playbooks (Demo Day activation kit, hackathon kit) that the Field Marketing team can scale across regions and segments 
 Establish baseline metrics, dashboards, and ROI reporting for all Public Sector field programs 
 Be the face of Anthropic in the Public Sector ecosystem — credible with strategic partners and agencies 
 
 You may be a good fit if you: 
 
 Direct Public Sector-segment experience — you have built and run programs targeting the Public Sector as your primary audience, not as an enterprise field marketer who occasionally touches Public Sector 
 End-to-end ownership of field marketing events and programs, hands on in both strategy and execution - this is a 0-1 building role with very little foundation in place 
 Repeat success across multiple companies — we are looking for a pattern of impact, scaling field or demand generation programs in different environments, not a single-company tour (however strong the brand) 
 0-to-1 builder DNA — you've built a field marketing motion from scratch (or rebuilt one), and you also have scaled-company tenure that grounds you operationally 
 Tight sales alignment — you've worked shoulder-to-shoulder with AEs and BDRs on account targeting, pre-event outreach, and post-event follow-up 
 Operational rigor — you can stand up vendor management, registration, follow-up workflows, and ROI dashboards without being asked 
 Technical credibility — you can review technical event content, brief technical speakers, and hold your own with founder/CTO audiences 
 
 Strong candidates may have: 
 
 10+ years across Field Marketing, Demand Generation, ABM, and Events at B2B technology companies 
 Experience working inside of a Public Sector organization that went through a rapid growth phase, or a blend of Public Sectors and scaled technology companies. 
 AI/ML field marketing experience 
 Existing relationships with public sector associations and research institutions 
 Visible thought leadership in the Public Sector ecosystem or developer ecosystem 
 
 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or Washington, D.C. office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $400,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.

And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. 
 We're looking for a Field Marketing Manager to support our LLM and OEM Partnerships team, one of the most strategically important and fastest-growing areas of our business. AI is transforming entire industries, and the data that powers it has to come from somewhere. Similarweb is one of those sources, and demand for what we provide to the world's leading AI companies is growing fast. This role exists to build the marketing engine that gets us in front of the right people, at the right companies, at the right time.This role comes with real ownership and few constraints - if you have an idea, you can run with it. This role is based in New York with regular travel to San Francisco, where much of the AI and data ecosystem lives, and building presence there is a core part of the job. 
 You will report to the Americas Field Marketing Director and work closely with our AI & OEM team to build brand presence, deepen relationships, and create meaningful moments with some of the biggest names in AI and tech. 
 So, what will you be doing all day? 
 
 Build and execute multi-channel marketing programs: digital, direct, and in-person - that get us in front of new buyers and nurture existing relationships at our highest-priority target accounts across tech companies 
 Own conference sponsorships and speaking opportunities end-to-end - strategy, logistics, on-site execution, and ROI measurement, with a focus on establishing Similarweb as a recognized name in the AI and data space 
 Plan and execute owned and co-hosted events, from intimate executive dinners to flagship activations 
 Run executive entertainment and on-site engagement programs with senior stakeholders at major tech companies 
 Support the buildout of a dedicated microsite, content calendar, and social presence for our AI and data partnerships business - including case studies, whitepapers, press releases, and blog content 
 Influence how Similarweb shows up in the AI and data ecosystem - from branding and messaging to in-person activations 
 Collaborate daily with the sales team to identify new opportunities, support active accounts, and keep marketing aligned with pipeline goals 
 Bring new ideas to the table and own them from first concept through final execution 
 
 This is the perfect job for someone who: 
 
 4+ years of experience in field marketing or partnerships marketing in a B2B environment 
 A track record of running events and programs end-to-end with complete ownership, the venue, the vendor, the internal approvals, the client-facing materials, and the follow-through 
 Experience managing budgets, vendors, and multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing track of the details 
 Strong relationship-building skills, both internally with fast-moving teams and externally with senior stakeholders at major tech companies 
 A proactive communication style - with their manager, with sales, with vendors 
 Curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI and data space - prior experience not required, but a hunger to learn is a must 
 Comfort with regular travel to San Francisco and to events and activations as needed 
 A self-starter mentality, someone who thrives with ownership and few constraints 
 Someone who brings creative energy to every touchpoint and is always looking for new ways to bring the brand to life 
 
 **At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.** 
 The base salary range for this position in New York City is $125,000 to $150,000 plus benefits including: medical, dental and vision insurance, 401K plan, potential equity, employee stock purchase plan and paid sick and parental leave. 
 Individual compensation is based upon several factors, including qualifications and relevant experience. 
 The base salary range above is for the New York City metro area and could vary for candidates in other locations. 
 Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

jobs.excerpt:
We are seeking an experienced people manager to lead a high-performing team of project managers responsible for delivering the programs that bring world-class creative campaigns to millions of grocery customers. This role combines strategic portfolio management with people leadership — directing the planning and execution of 50+ concurrent creative projects supporting enterprise-level business initiatives for WWGS Marketing and Brand. The ideal candidate excels at developing project management talent, orchestrating complex multi-channel portfolios, and maintaining high-quality outputs while navigating ambiguity at scale. This role requires someone who thrives in the creative process — comfortable navigating ambiguity, earning trust with creative teams who care deeply about their craft, and protecting the space for great work to happen while keeping complex programs on track. Key job responsibilities People Leadership & Development - Build and lead a team of 6+ Project Managers; provide mentorship, career development, and performance management (Hire and Develop the Best) - Foster a team culture of operational rigor, ownership, and a growth mindset; set and maintain a high bar for delivery quality (Insist on the Highest Standards) - Develop and implement training programs to enhance team capabilities and project management methodologies - Conduct regular 1:1s, team meetings, and performance reviews to ensure team growth, alignment, and success Portfolio & Program Management - Oversee a complex portfolio of marketing initiatives, ensuring strategic alignment and optimal resource allocation (Deliver Results) - Lead the most complex, high-impact programs within WWGS Marketing, focusing on large-scale, multi-channel creative campaigns - Establish portfolio governance frameworks and ensure consistent project delivery standards across the team (Insist on the Highest Standards) - Proactively identify risks and dependencies; devise mitigation plans and contingency options; escalate with recommended solutions when appropriate (Dive Deep) Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management - Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior leadership; translate operational data into strategic recommendations that align portfolio outcomes with marketing goals (Earn Trust) - Present progress, risks, and capacity trade-offs to senior stakeholders; influence prioritization decisions with clear data and business context (Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit) - Identify escalation trends across the portfolio; surface systemic issues and drive cross-functional alignment on resolution (Dive Deep, Bias for Action) - Act as a trusted partner to creative teams; understand the creative process and advocate for the time, space, and clarity creatives need to produce excellent work (Customer Obsession) - Lead strategic planning sessions and portfolio reviews, shaping initiatives and driving organizational change (Think Big) Operational Excellence - Design and implement scalable project management processes, templates, and best practices that raise the quality bar across the team (Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards) - Define and maintain operational KPIs and portfolio health dashboards; use data to identify inefficiencies and drive corrective action (Dive Deep) - Conduct post-delivery retrospectives; document learnings and implement systemic fixes that prevent recurrence across the portfolio (Learn and Be Curious) A day in the life No two days look the same — but here's a snapshot of what this role looks like in motion: Morning: You review capacity across the portfolio and flag emerging risks before they become blockers. You coach a PM through a tricky stakeholder conversation, then join a creative brief kickoff to ensure scope and timelines are realistic from the start. Midday: You're in a cross-functional planning session with Creative and Channel leads, aligning on Q4 priorities and making trade-off recommendations backed by data. You push back on a request that would overload your team — respectfully, with a clear alternative. Between meetings, you step into a complex multi-channel campaign to untangle a dependency that's stalling the creative team. Afternoon: You conduct a 1:1 with a developing PM, discussing their career goals and giving feedback on a recent retro they facilitated. Later, you prep a portfolio review for senior leadership — translating execution details into a concise story about what's on track, what's at risk, and what needs decision. Throughout the day: You're context-switching between strategic and tactical — unblocking a stalled approval, fielding a Slack thread about a shifting launch date, and connecting dots across programs that no one else sees. You protect your team's capacity so they can focus on the work, and you keep creative partners feeling heard even when the answer is "not yet." About the team The WWGS Brand & Sustainability organization is the brand-building and differentiation engine for Amazon’s Worldwide Grocery Stores business, encompassing Whole Foods Market and Amazon Grocery. Our Marketing Operations team sits at the center of this work — we are the connective tissue between Brand, Creative, Marketing, Channel, and external agency partners, ensuring world-class creative programs launch on time, on brand, and at scale. The Project & Resource Management team within Marketing Operations manages the end-to-end delivery of 50+ concurrent creative and marketing programs across channels including Signage, Site Merchandising, Onsite, Paid Media, Social & Influencer, and Email. We operate at the intersection of strategic planning and tactical execution, bringing order to complexity and enabling our creative teams to do their best work.

The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. The GTM Ops, Strategy, Field Readiness, and Sales Development team at Asana enables growth, efficiency, and performance at scale through the strategic management of revenue operations, systems, strategy + analytics, and enablement. You will own our end-user CPQ experience, drive our agentic quoting capability, and solve complex system dependencies across the broader GTM ecosystem to help Asana scale. 
 This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements. 
 What you’ll achieve 
 
 Partner as a key cross-functional thought leader with Sales, RevStrat, ET, Deal Desk, and Finance to design scalable, AI-ready workflows that accommodate evolving GTM motions.

 Execute end-to-end UAT by authoring test scenarios, managing edge cases, and establishing a reusable UAT framework for future releases.

 About you

 Deep hands-on expertise with Salesforce and the Sales Cloud ecosystem, alongside demonstrated experience designing complex CPQ platforms in production environments. 
 Strong systems-thinking perspective with the ability to map data flows, anticipate upstream/downstream impacts, and translate ambiguous needs into structured process documentation.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years. 
 What we do 
 The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! Role overview 
 The Brand Marketing Specialist will be responsible for leading all digital brand media campaigns across the US, Canada, and the UK. This role will shape digital investment strategies and own the creative lifecycle from brief to execution. Operating at the intersection of creative development and media strategy, this role will manage agency partners, track campaign performance, and oversee budgets to drive continuous optimization. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Work directly with the Brand Marketing Manager to determine our digital channel mix and investment strategy (e.g. Online Video, YouTube, Meta, TikTok). 
 Own the creative testing roadmap; partner with performance marketing and analytics teams to identify opportunities and structure testing plans. 
 Oversee the development of brand creative to fuel the digital media plan: 
 
 Draft creative briefs that are rooted in our brand story, customer insights, channel best practices, and campaign learnings.  
 Project-manage internal creative teams and external agencies, managing feedback, securing approvals, and trafficking final assets to media partners. 
 Maintain the brand team’s asset library and proactively identify opportunities to leverage assets and messaging across the organization. 
 
 Partner with analytics and engineering teams to advance digital brand measurement capabilities and translate creative learnings into actionable optimization strategies. 
 Monitor industry trends and identify emerging opportunities to drive continuous channel testing and expansion to drive performance improvements. 
 Generate and present monthly reports for mid-funnel channels across all active regions (US, CA, UK). 
 Responsible for budget planning and reconciliation for all mid-funnel digital brand channels. 
 
 What you'll bring 
 
 2+ years of professional marketing experience, preferably in consumer brand or performance marketing 
 Deep understanding of creative strategy and production, with a proven ability to connect creative insights directly to performance metrics and business outcomes. 
 Strong creative instincts with the ability to give clear, actionable direction and feedback to agencies and creative partners. 
 A data-driven approach to decision-making, with a focus on balancing long-term brand building with short-term conversions. 
 Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a track record of building cross-functional relationships and presenting to stakeholders. 
 Strong organizational skills and personal accountability, with experience managing budgets, project timelines, and competing priorities effectively. 
 Familiarity with leveraging generative AI tools to optimize creative workflows, speed up production, or streamline daily marketing tasks. 
 
   The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles. Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Position Pay Range $70,000 — $87,000 USD Working at CarGurus 
 We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. 
 We welcome all 
 CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.excerpt:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to grow Replit’s core creation products, including Design and Slides.

These products already give people new ways to turn an idea into something they can see, share, and use. Your job is to help more people discover them, understand when to use them, and make them part of their regular workflow.

You’ll own the connection between the product and its audiences: developing positioning grounded in customer needs, leading launches, finding channels that can drive sustained adoption, tracking the competitive landscape, and bringing market feedback back to Product.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Growth, Brand, and Creative. It is a hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, write the narrative, and get the work into the market.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the positioning and growth strategy for Replit’s core products, including Design and Slides. Develop audience-focused narratives, identify new use cases and channels, bring product improvements to market, and build programs that drive adoption, engagement, and conversion. Track competitors and customer needs, then translate those insights into sharper messaging, stronger go-to-market decisions, and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Self-starter: You take ownership, work through ambiguity, and move from strategy to execution without waiting for a perfect brief.

 - Audience-focused: You turn customer insight into clear positioning, relevant narratives, and campaigns built for specific audiences.

 - Growth-minded: You find creative ways to expand adoption, test new channels and tactics, and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.

 - Deep product background: You understand complex products, work closely with Product and Engineering, and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer value.

 - Strong product marketer: You bring 4+ years of experience growing product-led, consumer, prosumer, creative, or developer-focused products.

jobs.title: Derivative Sales Analyst (Prosumer Sales)
jobs.excerpt:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Derivative Sales Analyst on the Institutional team, you'll own and grow relationships with Coinbase's top prosumer derivatives traders, driving volume across futures, options, and perpetuals. You'll source new high-value traders from competitor venues, re-engage dormant accounts, and bring structured market and client insights back to Product, Risk, and Marketing to shape Coinbase's advanced trading offerings. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Own and grow relationships with top prosumer derivatives traders on Coinbase, driving increased trading volume, deepening engagement, and expanding adoption of advanced trading products. 
 Source and convert new high-value derivatives traders from competitor venues through targeted outbound, differentiated positioning of Coinbase's liquidity, fees, and UX, and full-funnel sales management. 
 Monitor derivatives market structure, client flows, and competitor offerings to identify upsell opportunities, inform pricing and product feedback, and deliver structured insights to Product, Risk, and Marketing. 
 Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast for your book, reporting on key KPIs (volume, active traders, winbacks, competitor migration) and documenting client interactions through CRM tooling. 
 Reactivate previously dormant top traders using data-driven account reviews, tailored outreach, and bespoke incentives to restore sustained volume. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 
 2+ years of sales or business development experience in financial services, trading, or crypto, with a track record of hitting or exceeding revenue and volume targets. 
 Strong understanding of derivatives products (futures, options, perps, margin) in traditional finance or crypto markets, including how active traders use them in practice. 
 Data-driven operating style with experience using dashboards, CRMs, and basic analytics to segment books, identify opportunities, and prioritize outreach. 
 Background in business, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience working directly with trading clients. 
 Series 3 License required, or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire. 
 Pre-existing book of high-value prosumer or retail derivatives clients preferred. 
 Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Discoverability
jobs.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City, Austin
jobs.excerpt:
About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 Search is changing. Developers no longer just type queries into Google — they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, and, increasingly, they don't ask at all: their coding agents do. When a developer prompts Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or v0 to build something, the framework, deployment target, and docs those agents reach for are decided before a human ever visits a website. This is existential for Vercel: we're the agentic infrastructure platform for the agent era, agents already trigger more than half of our deployments, and being the answer that both AI assistants *and* coding agents surface, cite, and build with is quickly becoming as important as ranking on page one. 
 We're hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own Discoverability end to end: how easily developers, teams, AI assistants, and coding agents find, understand, and choose Vercel across every surface where discovery happens. You'll own our organic footprint across traditional search (SEO) and answer engines (AEO/GEO) — where "answer engines" spans both conversational assistants and the coding agents developers build with — from the technical foundation that makes our content machine-readable to the content and structure that makes us the answer. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll set the discoverability strategy and execute it hands-on, partnering closely with Growth Product, Content, Web Engineering, and Developer Relations. You'll report to the Head of Growth and be a key driver of Vercel's product-led, self-serve growth engine. 
   
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Own Vercel's organic acquisition strategy across SEO and AEO/GEO, with clear goals for traffic, non-branded visibility, share of voice in AI answers, how often coding agents choose and recommend Vercel, and downstream signups.  
 Lead technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data (schema), Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, and internal linking — working directly in our stack and with Web Engineering to ship fixes. 
 Build our answer-engine strategy across both surfaces: (1) conversational assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google's AI surfaces, and (2) coding agents like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and v0. 
 Understand how each retrieves and cites content — including docs, llms.txt, structured data, and machine-readable references — and shape our surfaces so Vercel is the source they reference and the default they build with. 
 Partner with Content and PMM to build a scalable content and information architecture — programmatic pages, docs, comparison and solution pages, and editorial — that ranks and gets cited. 
 Define and own the measurement layer: instrument the funnel from organic and AI-referred discovery through to activation, choosing the tooling and building the dashboards that make discoverability performance legible to the wider company. 
 Run a continuous experimentation program (page structure, metadata, schema, content formats) and turn results into repeatable playbooks. 
 Own domain and technical health across our web properties in collaboration with Engineering — migrations, redirects, canonicalization, and international/localization structure. 
 Stay ahead of a fast-moving landscape and translate algorithm and AI-engine changes into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap. 
 
 About You: 
 
 6+ years in SEO, organic growth, or technical/growth marketing, with a track record of driving organic acquisition at scale — ideally for a product-led or self-serve business. 
 Genuinely technical: comfortable with structured data and schema, rendering and indexation, log-file and crawl analysis, and reading enough code to work directly in a CMS or codebase and spec fixes with engineers. 
 Familiarity with Next.js or modern frontend rendering is a strong plus. 
 Equally strong on the content and strategy side: you know how information architecture, page structure, and editorial quality drive both rankings and citations, and you can partner with writers and PMMs to make it happen. 
 Early, hands-on perspective on AEO/GEO across both conversational assistants and coding agents — you've experimented with how they retrieve, cite, and act on content (docs, llms.txt, structured references) and have opinions grounded in real tests, not just theory. 
 Fluent in the analytics stack (e.g., GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, BigQuery or similar) and able to define your own metrics, build dashboards, and defend priorities with data. 
 A self-starter who thrives with ambiguity and ownership, and can move between strategy and execution without waiting for direction 
 
 Bonus If You: 
 
 Experience marketing to developers or technical audiences is a strong plus. 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $150,000 - $207,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. 
 We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $500K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. 
 If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. 
 We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join our San Francisco Office. This is a high-execution, broad-scope role for someone who is organized and ambitious, loves being in the room when things happen, and finds genuine satisfaction in making complex logistics look effortless. You’ll be responsible for field marketing, community, campaign execution, and light office coordination. This is a role for someone who wants to become a strong marketing operator: the kind of person who can take a clear direction and turn it into reliable, organized action. 
 Why This Role Exists 
 We've opened a San Francisco office to strengthen our presence in the Voice AI market by expanding our field marketing programs. Sponsoring (and building campaigns around) third-party events, crafting executive dinners and experiences, and hosting community meetups are core to how we build relationships and awareness in our market—and we've reached the point where we need additional execution support on the ground in SF to get even more programs off the ground. 
 This role is a force multiplier for the marketing team. It will free up capacity to run a higher volume of events, grow our local community presence, and add execution support across campaigns and operations. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Community & Meetup Support 
 
 Help coordinate local community meetups and lighter-weight activations in San Francisco  
 Own invite management, RSVP tracking, reminders, venue coordination, materials prep, and post-event follow-up  
 Support relationship-building with community members, local partners, creators, and attendees  
 Help make SF-based community motions more consistent and easier to run at volume 
 Be physically present at events to support setup, registration, and on-the-ground execution 
 
 Campaign & Marketing Operations Support 
 
 Support email campaign execution—including list coordination, QA, asset organization, and execution follow-through

 Assist with campaign setup and tracking across event, lifecycle, community, and brand work  
 Learn marketing tools like Iterable (or similar) and contribute to process improvement over time

jobs.title: Program Manager, GTM Acceleration
jobs.excerpt:
About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 We are looking for a Program Manager to join our GTM Acceleration team. In this role, you’ll own the program management behind some of our highest-priority GTM initiatives and build the operating systems that turn important product releases into clear, timely action across the field. 
 You’ll lead complex programs like global enablement offsites, Sales Kickoff, Field Readiness Bootcamps, and other strategic GTM initiatives from planning through execution and follow-up. You’ll also own the process connecting Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) releases to GTM and ensure our teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and what they need to do differently. 
 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Field Engineering, and Enablement. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional work, keep teams aligned against fixed deadlines, and give leaders clear visibility into progress, risks, and decisions. 
 This role is hybrid, based out of our SF office and includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. 
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Program-manage Vercel’s highest-priority GTM initiatives—including global enablement offsites, Sales Kickoff, Field Readiness Bootcamps, and other strategic programs—from initial planning and workbacks through execution and follow-up. 
 Own the GTM enablement roadmap and calendar: intake, prioritization, sequencing, dependencies, readiness, conflicts, and regional coordination across programs. 
 Build and run the EPD-to-GTM release process for Tier 1 and Tier 2 launches, establishing clear owners, milestones, decisions, field ready supporting resources. 
 Enforce product-update communication standards across Slack and enablement channels, including the template, routing, timing, and exception path for urgent changes. 
 Provide leadership with a concise view of program status, risks, decisions, and dependencies without requiring them to chase updates. 
 
 About You: 
 
 You have 3+ years of experience in program management, strategy consulting, business operations, or a comparable cross-functional execution role, ideally in a fast-moving technology environment. 
 You have a track record of driving ambiguous, high-visibility programs with many contributors and fixed deadlines, and can bring structure to work that does not yet have a clear playbook. 
 An exceptional operator: you build clear plans, identify critical paths and dependencies, close open decisions, and reliably follow through from planning to execution. 
 Clear communicator who can influence senior cross-functional partners without formal authority 
 You understand enterprise B2B sales and GTM organizations well enough to anticipate what customer-facing teams need to be successful, and you can quickly develop fluency in technical products. 
 You look for ways to automate repetitive coordination and operational work, using AI and lightweight tooling to make processes faster and more scalable. 
 You thrive in environments with a high rate of change and are comfortable creating structure while the organization, product, and priorities continue to evolve. 
 
 Bonus If You: 
 
 Have worked at a B2B SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, or cloud platform company. 
 Have experience with sales enablement, field readiness, product launch operations, or large-scale internal programs. 
 Have experience designing intake, communications, or governance systems across Product & GTM 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $144,000 - $198,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have discovered what it feels like to work alongside AI that actually raises their game. Most people who could benefit from an AI collaborator haven't tried one yet, or tried once and didn't see what was possible. Closing that gap isn't a copywriting problem — it's a storytelling and enablement problem at a scale few companies have ever had to solve. That's what this role owns. 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the foundational positioning and story for Claude's core knowledge-work products — Chat, Cowork, and the broader non-coding suite. Everything that helps a knowledge worker understand what's possible, and a buyer decide with confidence, runs through your work: the website, the pitch decks, the battlecards, the persona narratives. You're not just making the case that people should adopt AI — you're equipping the people who decide to buy it and showing the people who use it, at the scale of millions, exactly how to put it to work. 
 This is an individual-contributor role built for someone who wants to do deep, durable craft work on products with enormous, established usage. You'll write the positioning doc, build the battlecards, and ship the persona work yourself, and you'll use Claude and AI-native workflows to keep those foundations self-updating and trusted by every team that depends on them. 
 If you've owned the full product marketing stack for a large, widely-used, fast-evolving product, have building instincts for turning your own PMM workflows into systems rather than one-off documents, and want your writing to be the reason millions of people and the buyers who equip them finally understand what an AI collaborator can do, this role is for you. 
 Responsibilities 

 Define the story that gets millions of people to change how they work. Own and evolve the positioning and messaging house for Chat, Cowork, and Claude's core knowledge-work products, so every deck, campaign, and piece of content makes the same compelling case for what's possible. 

 Give sellers the conviction to close. Build and maintain the sales enablement assets — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — that turn a good product into deals won, arming GTM to sell with confidence rather than guesswork. 

 Equip buyers to make the call with confidence. Own the proof points, comparisons, and narratives that help economic buyers and champions justify the purchase and adoption decision internally, not just the end users who'll use the product day to day. 

 Make sure the message lands with the right person, in their language. Develop ICP and persona frameworks that translate a broad, varied base of knowledge workers and buyers into insights sharp enough to drive messaging and campaigns that actually resonate. 

 Make our inspiring story come to life. Own the website and product page messaging that's often someone's very first encounter with what Claude can do for their work — the moment that decides whether they lean in or bounce. 

 Turn scattered wins into a playbook others can run. Build libraries of top use cases by product and by function or persona, so the best examples of AI-augmented work aren't one-off stories, they're patterns anyone can copy. 

 Keep every team telling the same story, well. Partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Partners so they're never working from stale or inconsistent materials. 

 "Claudify" our own foundations. Build AI-native systems, using Claude and beyond-chat workflows like Skills and automations, that keep positioning, messaging, personas, and enablement current and instantly trustworthy — proof, in how you work, of the same transformation you're asking millions of others to make. 

 Contribute to how we present plans, pricing, and analyst relations materials for the core knowledge-work portfolio as they intersect with your positioning and messaging work 

 You may be a good fit if you 

 Have proven experience owning positioning and messaging for an established software product used broadly across personas and use cases 

 Have strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt tone and complexity across formats — pitch decks, web copy, battlecards, persona docs 

 Have experience building ICP and persona frameworks and translating research into messaging that scales across websites, collateral, campaigns, and content 

 Have experience building sales enablement assets and working directly with sales teams on objection handling and win/loss dynamics 

 Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC, writing and shipping assets directly rather than through a team 

 Demonstrate systems thinking, and the ability to move fast and with conviction in an always-evolving environment 

 Are well-versed in using AI — namely Claude — to inform and automate product marketing workflows, and have built foundational systems that inform, update, and share PMM foundations with the stakeholders who depend on them 

 Have experience marketing AI or productivity software to a broad, cross-functional buyer base 

 Strong candidates may also have 

 Experience with analyst relations processes and reports (e.g., Gartner, Forrester) 

 Familiarity with plans and pricing presentation and packaging communication 

 Experience as a Senior PMM or PMM Lead at a productivity, collaboration, or knowledge-work software company with ownership of core-product positioning 

 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least once a month for cross-functional stakeholder engagement. Additionally, this role will require up to 40% travel for events and customer engagements. 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Strategic Delivery
jobs.excerpt:
About SimpliSafe 
 We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. 
 Why are we hiring? 
 Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.  
 What you’ll do 
 In this role, you'll partner with Go-to-Market and Customer Experience business teams to capture and document business needs into clear, actionable requirements, then work with Operations and Growth Engineering teams to translate those requirements into scoped, executable work. You'll help drive the day-to-day management and refinement of JIRA projects and backlogs, and help track progress against quarterly priorities. Acting as a liaison between business and technical teams, you'll keep requirements accurate through delivery, analyze data and processes to identify efficiency opportunities, and maintain reporting that gives stakeholders clear visibility into progress and timelines. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Requirements & Analysis 
 
 Elicit, document, and translate business needs into clear, detailed requirements (user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria) that align teams on scope and value 
 Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Product to support informed decisions, providing analysis on customer impact, technical feasibility, cost, and speed to market 
 Support end-to-end delivery of initiatives, from concept through launch and iteration, ensuring requirements remain accurate and actionable at every stage 
 Maintain and refine backlogs, support sprint planning, and assist prioritization using Agile methodologies in JIRA 
 Validate that delivered features and enhancements meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria across internal tools and platforms 
 
 Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication 
 
 Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, translating needs into clear, actionable requirements and process documentation 
 Support alignment across cross-functional partners (Engineering, Design, Marketing, CX, Enablement) by surfacing tradeoffs, dependencies, and impacts 
 
 What you'll bring 
 
 3-5 years of experience as a business analyst, project coordinator / manager, product owner or related roles 
 Utilization of AI tools to streamline process, build requirements documentation, and drive efficiencies 
 Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into clear and detailed requirements. 
 Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions 
 Proven ability to work across cross-functional teams and support delivery of complex initiatives 
 Experience working in Agile environments (Jira or similar tools) 
 Excellent communication, writing, and stakeholder management skills 
 Bachelor's Degree. A technical discipline (engineering or science) is a plus 
 
 What Values You’ll Share 
 
 Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them. 
 Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. 
 No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. 
 One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. 
 Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. 
 Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. 
 
 What We Offer 
 
 A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive   
 A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here ) 
 Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.  
 Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. 
 
 The target annual base pay range for this role is $107,900 to $143,800 
 This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.  
 Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be  found here . 
 We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values. 
 We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. 
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu 
 Media is one of Instacart's most powerful growth levers, and the team is actively evolving its operating model to serve multiple lines of business through a mix of in-house and agency-managed media. This role exists to design, own, and continuously improve the core mechanics of how the media team plans, executes, and optimizes work. Throughout, you'll dig into the "why" behind each program — not just tracking status, but making sure the team can always articulate the business outcome a program is meant to drive and how it's being measured.

 The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed. 
 We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users. 
 If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you. 
 What you’ll do 
 You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects. 
 This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management 
 Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics

 Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations  
 Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements  
 Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure 
 Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first 
 
 Who you are 
 You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.  
 You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

 6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks  
 Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments  
 Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales  
 Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

jobs.title: Associate Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done. We are seeking an Associate Product Marketing Manager to join our team and serve as the bridge between how our products actually work and how the world learns to use them. You will develop the deepest product understanding on the team and translate it into webinars and education materials that inspire adoption and drive growth.

If you have a passion for understanding how things work, thrive in taking something complex and making it simple, and want to build a world-class product education engine that turns new users into power users, this role is for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Know the product cold. Develop a deeper working knowledge of our products than anyone else in marketing, using every feature the day it ships, building the workflows yourself, and staying close to the teams that built them.

 - Turn complexity into clarity. Transform complex product capabilities into simple, specific, and accurate explanations, defining not just what we built, but how it works, when to use it, and why it matters.

 - Teach at scale. Own product webinars end to end, from content and live demos to delivery and follow-up, spanning onboarding series, feature deep-dives, and use-case walkthroughs.

 - Build the education engine. Create the product education materials our users learn from: how-to guides, demo flows, video walkthroughs, and use-case libraries that make customers materially better at their jobs.

 - Obsess over the user. Maintain a sharp, real-time view of what users misunderstand and where they get stuck, ensuring our education remains grounded in how people actually use the product rather than how we assume they do.

 - Measure outcomes, not just outputs. Tie webinars and education content to tangible activation, adoption, and retention, running lightweight experiments to iterate fast on format, content, and delivery.

 - Get products to launch. Own and coordinate the cross-functional workstreams that take products from built to launch, keeping teams aligned on dependencies, timelines, and the work needed to bring each launch to market.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2-3 years of experience in product marketing, customer education, business development, or a related role, ideally within a high-growth technology company, or work that proves the skill regardless of title.

 - Proven ability to synthesize complex technical concepts into simple, specific, and provable explanations that travel across new users, power users, and admins.

 - Genuine obsession with product: you explore every setting, test every new feature, and can explain what a product does better than the team that built it.

 - Sharp teaching and storytelling skills grounded in data, with the ability to summarize how a feature works in a single sentence and demonstrate it live.

 - High slope: you learn unfamiliar products and domains fast, and your rate of improvement is your standout trait.

 - Extreme comfort delivering clarity in high-velocity, ambiguous environments.

As a critical member of the GTM Operations team, you will support the current technology, identify improvements and enhancements, and define the systems strategy and roadmap. This is an amazing opportunity for someone who has strong business acumen coupled with strong technical expertise and loves making an impact through people, process, and technology. 
 The ideal candidate will work effectively with cross-functional teams (e.g. marketing, sales, customer success, finance, etc.) to design and implement best practice solutions in our CRM (Salesforce) and other revenue systems to effectively support our business objectives, streamline processes, and provide comprehensive insights and analytics. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Manage the administration, configuration, and integration of  Salesforce.com  and other tools across the GTM tech stack, including technologies for marketing automation, sales engagement, data enrichment, analytics, etc. 
 Define and maintain the systems strategy and roadmap. 
 Recommend and drive process and system improvement initiatives across the end-to-end revenue organization. 
 Ensure data quality, accuracy, and governance across all revenue systems.

 Work with cross-functional stakeholders to understand key objectives, define initiatives to improve business performance, and deliver technology solutions that align with business needs.

 Certified SFDC Administrator required with 3-5 years of relevant hands-on administration experience. 
 Experience with marketing automation and marketing analytics (such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, etc.). 
 Advanced level and/or other Salesforce certifications preferred (e.g. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, etc.). 
 Strong technical expertise and business acumen across end-to-end revenue (sales, marketing, etc.) processes and technologies (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, 6Sense, Docusign, Zoominfo, etc.). 
 Experience with system implementation and application support with outstanding project management and execution skills. 
 Ability to drive cross-functional initiatives across multiple stakeholders by determining key objectives, creating business requirements, and translating into system configuration and implementation. 
 Strong analytical skills and ability to leverage data to provide insights to guide business decisions and track revenue performance.
