jobs.title: General Marketing Manager, Amazon WorkSpaces
jobs.excerpt:
Amazon WorkSpaces enables organizations to provide secure, managed cloud desktops and applications to their workforce anywhere in the world. Customers rely on WorkSpaces to support remote and hybrid work, VDI modernization, and secure access to corporate applications without the complexity and cost of traditional desktop infrastructure. WorkSpaces is now expanding into the frontier of agentic AI, providing cloud desktops for AI agents that need to operate enterprise applications autonomously. We're looking for a General Product Marketing Manager to join the WorkSpaces Product Marketing team. This is an individual contributor role spanning three key marketing pillars: Content strategy, community development, and customer storytelling. You will own the content engine that keeps our partner, field, and web channels current and compelling, build and manage our customer story pipeline, and build community through events, social channels, and other forums. WorkSpaces is backed by meaningful investment and senior executive visibility. This is a chance to shape the narrative for a category-leading cloud desktop service in the quickly evolving agentic enterprise space. About the Role As a General Product Marketing Manager for Amazon WorkSpaces, you will own three interconnected pillars that drive how WorkSpaces is known and trusted in the market: Content strategy: You own the content engine for WorkSpaces updating existing content, coordinating new content development, and ensuring distribution across partner, field, and web channels. You are the person who makes sure our story is current, compelling, and reaching the right audiences in the right places. Community development: You build WorkSpaces' presence in the market through first-party and third-party conferences (including flagship re:Invent), securing speaking opportunities, and growing visibility where our customers and prospects engage. Customer storytelling: You fill and manage the customer story pipeline identifying advocates, shepherding their stories from interview through publication, and integrating customer proof points into outbound content plans across every channel. You will partner cross-functionally with product management, sales, partner marketing, field teams, and creative to ensure WorkSpaces has a consistent, high-quality presence everywhere customers engage. Key job responsibilities Content Own the WorkSpaces content calendar and ensure all content assets are current, accurate, and aligned to the latest product positioning and launches. Coordinate new content development—including whitepapers, blog posts, solution briefs, web pages, and sales enablement materials—from concept through publication. Ensure content is distributed and activated across partner channels, field teams, and web properties (aws.amazon.com, partner portals, sales hubs). Partner with web content, campaigns, demand generation, and partner marketing teams to integrate WorkSpaces content into broader go-to-market initiatives. Community Own the first-party and third-party event strategy for WorkSpaces, including event selection, messaging, content, and execution planning. Lead WorkSpaces' presence at re:Invent driving session proposals, demo content, booth experiences, chalk talks, and executive customer engagements. Identify and secure speaking opportunities at industry events where WorkSpaces customers and prospects engage (e.g., Gartner DEX, EUC conferences, partner events). Grow WorkSpaces' market presence through social engagement, ecosystem participation, and community-building with customers and partners. Customer Identify and develop relationships with customers who have transformed their organizations with WorkSpaces. Understand their journey, quantify their impact, and craft narratives that resonate across audiences. Build and maintain a pipeline of customer advocates and reference accounts. Work with customer success and sales teams to identify high-impact stories and secure customer participation. Shepherd customer stories through the full lifecycle—from identification and interview through legal approval, production, and publication—and integrate them into outbound content plans. Define the customer storytelling roadmap, aligning stories to product launches, campaigns, and market moments where social proof will have maximum impact. Why This Role is Different WorkSpaces is the category leader in cloud desktops, trusted by the world's most security-conscious organizations. Unlike point solutions, WorkSpaces spans the full spectrum—from individual knowledge workers to enterprise-wide deployments of tens of thousands of desktops, and now into the frontier of AI agents that need secure, flexible, and scalable compute environments. The stories you tell will range from IT transformation at global enterprises to individual productivity wins, giving you narrative range across executive-level impact stories and hands-on user experiences. This role gives you ownership across three high-impact areas rather than a single narrow swim lane. You will shape how WorkSpaces shows up at re:Invent, what customers say about us, and what content reaches the field every day. This comes with meaningful investment, senior leadership visibility, and the opportunity to define the go-to-market motion for a product that enterprises depend on. About the team Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

We are seeking a talented Marketing Manager to join the US Sports Marketing team, focused on driving the rapid growth and expansion of local sports channels on Prime Video. This is a critical moment in the sports rights industry and Prime Video is positioned to offer the best experience for customers seeking access to their favorite regional teams. In this role, you will lead owned and operated (O&O) marketing execution across Amazon surfaces to drive awareness, subscriptions, and viewership for our growing portfolio of local sports channels. You will manage end-to-end campaign execution from conception through launch, ensuring flawless delivery across a rapidly expanding slate of channel partners. This role requires a strategic and analytical mindset with a strong foundation in performance marketing, growth marketing, and experimentation. You will own the development and optimization of audience targeting, campaign measurement, and A/B testing to maximize subscription growth, reduce churn, and drive live event tune-in. Given the unique cadence of live sports and the localized nature of the content, this function serves as the subject matter expert for local sports channels across all cross-functional teams and shared services related to O&O marketing within Prime Video. About the team Prime Video has a vast selection of live and on demand sports content including Thursday Night Football, NBA, WNBA, and more. The Sports Marketing team is charged with creating world-class marketing campaigns to deliver this growing portfolio of live sports content to Amazon customers.

jobs.excerpt:
Business Value Marketing Manager 
 Team: Marketing – Business Value Services · Reports to: Head of Business Value Services · Location: San Francisco 
 About Sigma 
 Sigma is the cloud analytics platform built directly on the data warehouse. Business teams use it to explore live data with the ease of a spreadsheet and to build interactive data apps on top of Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, with AI now doing a growing share of the work. We crossed $200M in ARR and raised an $80M Series E at a $3B valuation, and we are growing fast. 
 The role 
 This is value marketing , owned by Business Value Services: turning the outcomes customers have already realized into proof the go-to-market team uses to win and expand accounts. 
 As our Business Value Marketing Manager, you'll own how the value customers realize with Sigma becomes proof the whole go-to-market team can use. You'll build the system that tells us which customers are seeing results and why, then turn those outcomes into a steady supply of published proof and reference-ready advocates that sales and Business Value Services can pull from to win and expand accounts. 
 This is an individual-contributor role and an entry point into marketing at Sigma. 
 What you'll own 
 
 The value-proof engine Build and run the system that turns customer outcomes into published proof on a predictable cadence: case studies, videos, and quote cards grounded in real outcome data. This role turns customer outcomes into proof for prospects, the market, and the sales team. 
 Advocacy and references Grow a referenceable-customer bench relevant to our field sales teams, run the advocacy program, and feed Majors and ABM with proof tied to the value a customer has already realized. 
 Value stories at events Source and prepare customer speakers for our biggest annual events such as Snowflake Summit, Databricks DAIS, and our own Workflow conference. Own the Sigma User Meetups (SUMs) webinar series. 
 Reviews and recognition Drive review volume and quality on G2 and Gartner Peer Insights, and run programs like "Built with Sigma" awards that give customers a reason to put their name next to ours. 
 The Customer Advisory Board Own and mature Sigma’s CAB program in partnership with Business Value Services, and turn what you hear into both product input and pipeline. 
 Cross-Functional Distribution of Resources Bring relevant stories into the website, the sales plays, and the ABM pages. 
 The agentic stack Operate the AI-first system (Sigma, Claude, and the connected tooling) so drafting, repurposing, and distribution run at a volume one person plus agents can sustain, and improve that system as you go. 
 
 What you bring 
 
 Three to five years in B2B SaaS value marketing, customer advocacy, customer reference, customer success, BVS, or a closely related field. This is an entry point into marketing, so adjacent experience counts.   
 A track record of creating proof and references yourself, not only executing an existing playbook. 
 Strong writing and storytelling instinct, and the judgment to find the one outcome in a customer conversation that a prospect will actually care about. 
 Comfort with AI tooling. You have built, or are eager to build, agentic workflows, and you are not precious about doing by hand what an agent can do better. 
 Data fluency. You can work inside a warehouse-native analytics product, pull your own outcome numbers, and partner with RevOps without needing everything handed to you. 
 Event and customer-speaker exposure, and the diplomacy to manage customer relationships and executive stakeholders 
 A cross-functional operator who works across sales, Business Value Services, customer success, product marketing, and field marketing without friction. 
 
 Additional Job details 
 The base salary range for this position is $126 - 148k annually. 
 Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work at Sigma Computing. This role is eligible for stock options, as well as a comprehensive benefits package. About us:  
 Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.  
 Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year. 
 Come join us! 
 Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees: 
 
 Equity                                                                                                  
 Generous health benefits 
 Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need! 
 Paid bonding time for all new parents 
 Traditional and Roth 401k 
 Commuter and FSA benefits

 Dog friendly office

We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status.  You'll own paid acquisition at Vercel across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels, with one goal driving the work: scalable, profitable customer acquisition for our self-serve and enterprise motions.

What Is the Role 
 Regional Marketing Manager, SLED 
 Elastic is hiring a Regional Marketing Manager to own and grow our State, Local & Education (SLED) business through targeted, high-impact marketing programs. You'll sit at the intersection of field sales and marketing — building campaigns that drive real pipeline, not just activity. 
 This is a hands-on role. You'll design and run your own programs — field events, executive dinners, partner activations, content campaigns — while working closely with a field sales team that depends on you to move deals forward. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment, love the details, and know the SLED market, this is the role for you. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Own regional demand generation for SLED — from strategy through execution — across field events, account-based programs, trade shows, content syndication, and partner conferences 
 Partner daily with field sales and solution architects to align programs to pipeline goals and SLED buying cycles 
 Build and manage GTM programs with cross-functional teams including partner marketing, digital, campaigns, finance, and operations 
 Set goals and metrics for every program and track performance through weekly reports and monthly dashboards 
 Develop event content, agendas, and presentations in collaboration with stakeholders across the business 
 Manage multiple programs simultaneously, keeping everything on time and on budget 
 Identify and test new tactics and channels to expand reach and improve efficiency 
 Travel to programs and events approximately 25% of the time

 Proven regional or field marketing experience with deep knowledge of the SLED market and its buying dynamics 
 A track record of building programs that generate pipeline, not just leads

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Global Builder Lofts , Developer Experience
jobs.excerpt:
AWS Developer Experience is looking for a Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end marketing strategy and digital presence for the AWS Builder Loft program globally. Builder Lofts are physical developer community spaces where builders come together for hands-on workshops, hackathons, technical talks and networking. This role is critical for driving awareness and sustained audience growth through data-driven campaigns, compelling content, and seamless integration between physical touchpoints and digital engagement. This is a high-impact role that requires a marketer who combines strong storytelling with multi-channel marketing experience, thinks globally while executing locally, and understands developer communities. We're looking for someone who has the ability to build marketing playbooks, mechanisms, and scalable frameworks that allow a fast-growing global program to operate with consistency and efficiency. You leverage AI tools and automation to multiply your impact, move faster, and continuously improve marketing performance. You will work cross-functionally with PR, community, events, developer advocacy, and product teams across different geographies to build repeatable strategies and execution frameworks for a rapidly scaling global program. Key job responsibilities - Promotion Strategy: Develop and execute the Loft promotion strategy across AWS-owned and third-party email programs, social media, web, and grassroots channels to drive awareness, events registration/attendance and returning visitors - Registration & CRM Management: Manage event registration platforms and ensure seamless data flow to marketing CRMs, maintaining data integrity and enabling automated nurture workflows. - Content Calendar & Publishing: Own the content calendar for the Builder Loft content series showcasing Loft experiences, builder stories, and hands-on learning opportunities. Coordinate with team members and external partners to drive content creation and ensure editorial quality. - KPI Tracking & Reporting: Track and report on marketing KPIs including registration conversion rates, email open/click rates, social media engagement, content reach, and web monthly active users. - Audience Analysis: Conduct demographic and cohort analysis of Loft attendees to inform programming and outreach decisions. Own attendee data analysis, identifying trends in audience composition, repeat attendance, and engagement patterns. - PR Coordination: Coordinate with AWS PR teams high-profile event announcements, ensuring consistent messaging and maximum media impact. - Localization: Lead localization efforts where necessary, adapting marketing materials, campaigns, and content for local markets while maintaining brand consistency. - Physical-to-Digital Engagement Strategy Ownership: Designing the strategy that moves builders from initial awareness and in-person attendance into sustained always-on digital engagement. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the Community & Partnerships Manager on community channel promotion and co-marketing with partners. Work effectively across AWS with groups such as developer advocacy, digital marketing, field marketing, sales, and startup teams. A day in the life You start the morning working on a social media campaign highlighting the communities that the Builder Loft has been working with for the past year with the goal of acquiring new strategic partners who can host events in the space. You use an AI summarization tool to pull key information about previous campaign data, audience insights, industry trends, social media platform know-hows and feed them into the plan. Mid-morning, you join a cross-functional sync with the PR team to align on the messaging framework for an upcoming high profile Builder Loft event. After that, you're reviewing the content calendar, writing an article, and briefing your agency partner on assets needed for the next campaign sprint. In the afternoon, you're building a new campaign playbook, documenting the end-to-end process for a "city launch" so that when the next Builder Loft opens, there's a repeatable, high-quality execution plan ready to deploy. You close the day by organizing customer feedback you’ve seen online and compiling a collection of social media posts and other coverage, sending a Slack recap to your team members with synthesized insights and trends. 

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion - Experience in designing and producing content for a technical audience, such as Software Engineers, System Administrators, or IT professionals - Experience analyzing digital marketing campaigns, patterns and data trends to determine if they are meeting business objectives, and in turn leading recommendations to optimize - - Experience managing event registration or marketing automation platforms (e.g., Cvent, Marketo, HubSpot, or similar).

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities - - Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to drive efficiency, personalization, and scale - - Familiarity with community-led growth strategies and grassroots marketing. - -Experience in event marketing - - Experience coordinating with PR teams on product launches or location openings. ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll make things happen–fast.   
 As a GTM Consultant II, you will serve as a consultant within ZI Labs, the Professional Services arm of ZoomInfo, supporting enterprise engagements that help organizations design, implement, and optimize data-driven go-to-market strategies that drive measurable revenue outcomes. 
 ZI Labs partners with ZoomInfo's most strategic customers to transform their revenue operations through advisory services spanning GTM strategy, data architecture, account intelligence, demand generation, and operational enablement. You will work alongside experienced consultants across the full engagement lifecycle, from initial assessment and strategic design through implementation and adoption, contributing to client deliverables while taking on increasing ownership over time. 
 This is an early-career role for candidates who bring strong analytical ability, clear judgment, and the ability to translate between technical detail and business outcomes. We are looking for people with the raw consulting instincts that matter most: structured thinking, composure in ambiguous situations, and the presence to engage senior stakeholders with credibility. 
 What You'll Do: 
 
 Support consulting engagements end to end, owning defined workstreams and taking on greater responsibility as you develop. 
 Structure ambiguous inputs — client data, stakeholder requests, loosely defined problems — into clear analysis and actionable recommendations. 
 Develop consulting artifacts including analyses, strategy decks, process maps, and playbooks to an executive-ready standard. 
 Analyze and validate client data, assess data quality, and articulate the business implications of your findings. 
 Contribute to client and executive working sessions, and over time help facilitate them, translating technical findings into decisions stakeholders can act on. 
 Apply generative AI and intelligent automation tools to improve the speed and quality of delivery, and identify new opportunities to use them. 
 Collaborate with Product, RevOps, CX, and Sales teams to ensure solution feasibility and delivery quality. 

 What You Bring: 
 
 0–2 years of experience in consulting, professional services, revenue operations, product, business operations, or a comparable analytical or client-facing role, ideally within B2B SaaS. Candidates from adjacent backgrounds and recent graduates with relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply. 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. 
 A demonstrated ability to own a project, initiative, or responsibility and drive it to a measurable outcome with minimal oversight. 
 Comfort with data and quantitative reasoning, including proficiency in spreadsheets and rigorous reasoning with numbers. A genuine willingness to develop SQL and modern data skills is essential; formal experience is a plus. 
 Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences without oversimplifying. 
 Professional presence and poise, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders credibly and contribute substantively to the conversation. 
 Familiarity with, and demonstrated curiosity about, generative AI tools and their practical applications. 
 A structured, resourceful approach to unfamiliar problems and a bias toward making progress under ambiguity. 
 
 Nice to Have: 
 
 Prior experience at a management consulting firm, professional services organization, or B2B SaaS company. 
 Working knowledge of SQL, Snowflake, Databricks, or other hands-on data analysis. 
 Familiarity with GTM technology ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, and intent platforms. 
 A track record of stepping into leadership or high-responsibility roles early. 
 Evidence of having built something new, such as a tool, analysis, process, or venture.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Amazon Music Experiences
jobs.excerpt: Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. The Amazon Music Experiences team is seeking a Campaigns Manager to own the full lifecycle of experiential campaigns sold to brand partners. This role sits at the intersection of sales enablement, brand partnerships, and campaign execution, owning both the pre-sale and post-sale experience for brands investing in Amazon Music's experiential portfolio. You will work directly with brands and agencies to sell, scope, and deliver world-class experiential activations that connect fans to music and culture in meaningful ways. As a Campaigns Manager, you will be responsible for building and managing relationships with brand partners and their agency teams, developing compelling experiential proposals, and ensuring flawless execution from signed IO to post-campaign wrap. You will serve as the primary point of contact for brand and agency stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle, translating client objectives into activations that deliver measurable results. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, can manage competing priorities across multiple live campaigns, and brings a customer-obsessed mindset to every interaction. You will travel approximately 40% of the time to be on-site at activations, client meetings, and industry events. Key job responsibilities Role Summary **Pre-Sale** - Develop and present experiential campaign proposals to brands and agencies, articulating the value of Amazon Music's experiential platform and partnership opportunities. - Build and maintain a pipeline of brand prospects, proactively identifying alignment between brand objectives and Amazon Music's experiential offerings. - Partner with internal sales teams to craft custom packages that meet brand KPIs while protecting the integrity of the fan experience. - Lead pitch meetings and RFP responses, tailoring narratives to brand and agency audiences. - Develop case studies and sell sheets that demonstrate ROI and creative impact of past activations. - Drive toward and exceed a personal sales goal of $2M+ annually through new business development and renewals. **Post-Sale** - Own end-to-end campaign management from contract execution through wrap report delivery, bringing each experience to life with precision and creative excellence. - Serve as the day-to-day brand and agency contact, managing expectations, timelines, and deliverables. - Coordinate cross-functionally with production, creative, legal, finance, artist teams, and marketing to deliver on campaign commitments. - Manage campaign budgets, ensuring accurate forecasting and reconciliation. - Develop and deliver post-campaign reporting that quantifies brand value, audience engagement, and earned media impact. - Identify upsell and renewal opportunities based on campaign performance and evolving brand needs. **Building Experiences and Fan Integration** - Collaborate with artist teams to ensure brand activations complement and enhance the artist vision, creating authentic moments that resonate with fans. - Design fan-first experiences that integrate brand messaging organically into the event environment, prioritizing fan engagement over passive exposure. - Work with internal stakeholders across Amazon Music programming, marketing, and product to align experiential activations with broader strategic priorities. - Champion the fan perspective in all campaign decisions, ensuring every touchpoint delivers value to the audience while meeting brand objectives. **Agency and Brand Relationship Management** - Build trusted advisor relationships with agency planners, buyers, and brand marketing leads, driven by a customer-obsessed approach to partnership. - Educate agency and brand partners on Amazon Music's experiential capabilities, audience insights, and emerging formats. - Navigate complex multi-stakeholder environments across holding companies, independent agencies, and direct-to-brand relationships. - Represent Amazon Music Experiences at industry events, client summits, and agency days. **Internal Stakeholder Management** - Manage cross-functional relationships with production, creative, legal, finance, artist relations, and programming teams to ensure seamless campaign delivery. - Proactively communicate campaign status, risks, and opportunities to leadership and partner teams. - Operate as the connective tissue between external client needs and internal operational capabilities, translating between both audiences fluently. About the team The Amazon Music Experiences team is a pioneering business unit within Amazon Music that operates at the intersection of music, culture, brand partnerships, and live fan engagement. We are an industry-first experiences marketplace, creating a new revenue category by connecting premium brands with fans through immersive, culturally resonant activations tied to Amazon Music's artist programming and tentpole moments. Our team builds, sells, and executes experiential campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising. We design physical and hybrid activations where brands show up authentically alongside artists and fans, creating moments that drive emotional connection, cultural relevance, and measurable business outcomes for our partners. What We Do We own the full lifecycle of experiential brand partnerships, from concept creation through sales through on-the-ground execution and post-campaign measurement. Our work spans: - **Artist-Led Activations**: Partnering with artist teams to build branded experiences that complement and amplify the artist's creative vision while delivering value for brand partners. Our portfolio includes landmark executions such as Kendrick Lamar's Pop Out Experience, Bad Bunny's Residency Experience, De La Soul's DAISY Experience, and the Amazon Music 50 and Forever campaign celebrating 50 years of HipHop. - **Live Programming Integration**: Creating brand experiences within Amazon Music Live programming, including the Thursday Night Football television series, where brands engage fans in real-time cultural moments. - **Fan-First Experience Design**: Every activation we build starts with the fan. We design experiences where brand presence enhances the moment rather than interrupting it, ensuring fans walk away with a memory, not a media impression. - **Experiences Marketplace**: We have architected a scalable business model that packages Amazon Music's cultural access, artist relationships, and fan touchpoints into a marketplace where brands can invest in experiences across a range of formats, budgets, and objectives. How We Work We operate as a cross-functional team embedded within Amazon Music's Global Creative Organization (GCO), partnering closely with artist relations, programming, marketing, production, legal, and finance. Externally, we work directly with brands and their agency partners to develop custom experiential solutions. Our team thrives in ambiguity. jobs.title: GTM Contract Recruiter
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 At Samsara, we believe our people are our greatest investment, and hiring is a critical part of our success. We’re looking for a talented Contract Recruiter to partner closely with our growing GTM teams—hiring across functions such as Customer Success, Sales Operations, Sales Programs, Renewals, Sales Data Science, and Sales Enablement—to build a strong pipeline of top-tier candidates. This role is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow their career while helping scale high-performing teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 
 This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 
   
 You should apply if: 
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment. 
 You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. 
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  
 
 In this role, you will:   
 
 Manage Full-Cycle Recruiting: Create and implement strategies to solve problems and build diverse pipelines across Samsara’s corporate teams through sourcing, referrals, research, events, and social media. Find and engage passive candidates through creative sourcing techniques and help them envision life at Samsara. Effectively manage multiple requisitions and candidates during high-volume periods while creating and owning a flawlessly positive candidate experience 
 Be a Talent Advisor: Partner closely with hiring leaders to deeply understand their teams and goals. Organize and facilitate interview debriefs and drive offer approval, extension, and negotiation. Identify closing strategies for offers and proactively provide candidates with the appropriate information to help make their decision as easy as possible 
 Influence with data:  Independently address and unblock data analysis challenges. Extract and synthesize insights. Identify headwinds and tailwinds with a search.  
 Communicate Effectively: Tailor written and verbal communication to different audiences and situations. 
 Manage Stakeholders: Be seen as a trusted partner by other key cross-functional points of contact. Able to identify friction points, set appropriate expectations, and drive initiatives to overcome obstacles with a search.  
 Be a Diversity Advocate : Develop and implement sourcing strategies and marketing programs to identify top talent and build diverse candidate pipelines. Advise on structured interview processes that mitigate unconscious bias. Coach leaders and interviewers in inclusive interviewing best practices and objective feedback.  
 Process Excellence: Track pipeline data and provide relevant and consistent updates to hiring managers. Maintain high attention to detail when entering data into Greenhouse and other recruiting tools 
 Be a Cultural Champion: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 
 Minimum requirements for this role: 
 
 4+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment 
 Ability to create, measure, and scale the right workflow between candidates, hiring managers, and the recruiting team 
 Proven strategic sourcing skills  
 Team player with an eye for talent who loves connecting people and opportunities 
 Able to confidently represent Samsara with professionalism both internally and externally 
 Target-driven, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to bring up others around you 
 Previous tech experience preferred, and an unwavering ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
 Familiarity with Greenhouse or equivalent ATS experience 
 BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience 
 The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $83,538 — $126,360 USD Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, relig

Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 At Samsara, we believe our people are our greatest investment, and hiring is a critical part of our success. We’re looking for a talented Recruiter to partner closely with our growing GTM teams—hiring across functions such as Customer Success, Sales Operations, Sales Programs, Renewals, Sales Data Science, and Sales Enablement—to build a strong pipeline of top-tier candidates. This role is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow their career while helping scale high-performing teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 
 This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 
   
 You should apply if: 
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment. 
 You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. 
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  
 
 In this role, you will:   
 
 Manage Full-Cycle Recruiting: Create and implement strategies to solve problems and build diverse pipelines across Samsara’s corporate teams through sourcing, referrals, research, events, and social media. Find and engage passive candidates through creative sourcing techniques and help them envision life at Samsara.  Influence with data:  Independently address and unblock data analysis challenges. Extract and synthesize insights. Identify headwinds and tailwinds with a search.  
 Communicate Effectively: Tailor written and verbal communication to different audiences and situations. 
 Manage Stakeholders: Be seen as a trusted partner by other key cross-functional points of contact. Able to identify friction points, set appropriate expectations, and drive initiatives to overcome obstacles with a search.  
 Be a Diversity Advocate : Develop and implement sourcing strategies and marketing programs to identify top talent and build diverse candidate pipelines. Advise on structured interview processes that mitigate unconscious bias. Coach leaders and interviewers in inclusive interviewing best practices and objective feedback.  
 Process Excellence: Track pipeline data and provide relevant and consistent updates to hiring managers. Maintain high attention to detail when entering data into Greenhouse and other recruiting tools 
 Be a Cultural Champion: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 
 Minimum requirements for this role: 
 
 4+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment 
 Ability to create, measure, and scale the right workflow between candidates, hiring managers, and the recruiting team 
 Proven strategic sourcing skills  
 Team player with an eye for talent who loves connecting people and opportunities 
 Able to confidently represent Samsara with professionalism both internally and externally 
 Target-driven, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to bring up others around you 
 Previous tech experience preferred, and an unwavering ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
 Familiarity with Greenhouse or equivalent ATS experience 
 BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. 
   All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy . 
   AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. About the Role: 
 We're looking for an Event Marketing Manager to bring Gusto to life through bold, memorable events and experiences. 
 This is a highly visible, strategic role responsible for designing, producing, and optimizing event marketing programs—from trade shows and industry conferences to Gusto-owned activations and experiences. You'll plan, execute, and optimize event marketing campaigns as part of a cross-functional go-to-market team, turning strategy into on-the-ground execution that builds brand affinity and builds pipeline. 
 About the Team: 
 This role is part of the go-to-market team responsible for driving pipeline and fueling growth across Gusto's channels. We combine creativity, data-driven insights, and cross-functional collaboration to design campaigns that reach, engage, and convert the right audiences at scale. Together, we've helped Gusto grow to serve hundreds of thousands of customers nationwide, and we're just getting started. 
 Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: 
 
 Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership to set goals, develop event strategies, execute plans, and evaluate performance to drive continuous improvement over time. 
 Build and manage end-to-end event campaign programs including scopes of work, resource plans, budgets, contracts, and timelines—keeping everything on track and on budget. 
 Leverage a deep understanding of Gusto's internal and external market positioning and target audiences to inform event decisions, from format and venue selection to messaging and audience targeting. 
 Design and produce a range of event types—from large-scale owned events (500+ attendees) to trade show activations, field events, and intimate customer experiences—that strengthen brand affinity and accelerate funnel impact. 
 Build strong relationships with external partners including industry and show organizers, agencies, and vendors, negotiating favorable terms and ensuring seamless delivery. 
 Assemble the right internal and external resources for each opportunity, fostering collaboration and creative excellence with Gusto's creative teams, agencies, and production partners. 
 Maintain accuracy and accountability of event budgets, evaluate results against goals, deliver wrap-up reports, and make recommendations to senior leadership for Event Marketing. 
 Build upon and advocate for the event marketing and production craft and vision at Gusto—championing breakthrough experience design, emerging event technology, and innovative production approaches. 
 Leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance event marketing workflows—from audience analysis and content personalization to post-event reporting and campaign optimization—driving efficiency and deeper insights across the event lifecycle. 
 
 Here’s what we're looking for: 
 
 A track record of producing a wide range of events (trade shows, activations, conferences, owned events for 500+ attendees, and white-glove experiences) across varying levels of complexity, scale, and design. 
 A passion for event marketing and production with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get hands-on in execution—you move effortlessly between big-picture strategy and intricate operational details. 
 Strong project management and communication skills with a proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders at all levels and across different geographies, keeping complex programs running on time and on budget. 
 Experience managing and collaborating with internal creative teams and external agencies, driving alignment and excellence in production delivery. 
 Passionate and knowledgeable about breakthrough experience design and emerging event technology, always looking for new ways to elevate the craft. 
 A natural cross-functional collaborator who thrives on building and maintaining relationships across the organization to drive results. 
 An intellectually curious self-starter who isn't afraid to ask questions and uses answers to bring clarity and direction to the broader team. 
 AI fluency and a willingness to integrate AI-powered tools into your workflow to work smarter and unlock new possibilities. 
 Comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while building scalable programs and processes. 
 Note: this role requires frequent travel throughout North America. 
 
 Compensation 
 Our cash compensation amount for this role is $129,000/yr to $157,000/yr in Denver and Scottsdale and $154,000/yr to $188,000/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. 
 Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale. 
 Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.  
 When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees. 
 
 Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.  
 Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you. 
 Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer . 
 Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to  Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice .

Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.  
 What you’ll do 
 To further this important mission, we are looking for consultative and creative recruiters to grow and scale our Go-to-Market (GTM) team. The GTM organization at Stripe encompasses our Sales team, Marketing and Sales Development, GTM and Product Operations, and Professional Services. These teams are expanding in the region, focusing on bringing new users onto the Stripe platform, supporting our existing users' scale, and growing their businesses. You can expect high impact and wide-ranging responsibilities: owning full-cycle recruiting, driving hiring strategy, and delivering best-in-class candidate experience. This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to identify and engage top talent, ensuring a robust and inclusive candidate pool for current and future hiring needs 
 Conduct regular market research and analysis to stay informed about talent trends, using insights to inform recruiting strategies and address potential challenges 
 Partner with senior leaders across the organization to understand their hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies aimed at achieving headcount goals, with an emphasis on expanding our GTM teams across the US, LatAM and Canada 
 Track and analyze recruiting metrics, providing regular reports on hiring progress to business leadership to ensure transparency and alignment with goals 
 Propose and implement creative and scalable changes to the existing recruiting strategy to enhance efficacy and reach 
 Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal—to deliver a seamless and high-quality candidate experience 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 4+ years of full-cycle Recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment including in house experience 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 Strong ability to build relationships with senior leaders and effectively influence decision-making processes 
 Strong drive to identify and engage top talent, fostering relationships with candidates 
 Proven ability to utilize data insights to identify trends and refine recruiting processes, enhancing efficiency and outcomes 
 Flexibility, adept at shifting tasks and priorities in response to changing circumstances 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), such as Greenhouse, Lever, or similar platforms 
 Experience leveraging sourcing and CRM tools (e.g., Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter) to build and manage talent pipelines 
 Strong working knowledge of recruiting analytics and reporting tools to drive data-informed hiring strategies 
 Familiarity with scheduling, communication, and collaboration tools (e.g., GoodTime, Slack, G Suite)  
 Ability to quickly adopt new recruiting technologies and optimize workflows for scale

jobs.excerpt:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase . 
 As a Performance Marketing Manager on the Growth Marketing team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own Coinbase's global performance marketing program, managing hundreds of millions in ad spend across paid search, paid social, and mobile channels to drive new user acquisition at or above ROI targets. You'll scale our customer base and revenue through data-driven, full-funnel acquisition strategies, building the playbooks and measurement frameworks that connect channel performance to downstream business outcomes. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Own end-to-end strategy and execution across global paid performance channels (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and mobile UA) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets. 
 Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing experiences, translating results into scaled playbooks for global markets. 
 Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and measurement frameworks that connect channel performance to downstream business outcomes. 
 Lead platform relationships with Google, Meta, TikTok, and others, aligning on betas, measurement approaches, and joint growth plans to unlock new capabilities. 
 Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel, proactively surfacing insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership. 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 
 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience with expertise spanning paid search, paid social, and/or mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment. 
 Proven track record owning large-scale media budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets. 
 Demonstrated experience leveraging LLMs, no-code/low-code platforms, and automation tools (e.g., Zapier, n8n, Make, Retool) to prototype custom agents and AI-driven workflows that accelerate growth experimentation and scale campaigns. 
 Proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau) and a demonstrated experimentation mindset, with experience building and launching tests, interpreting results, and making data-grounded decisions. 
 Experience with full-funnel measurement across app and web, including event strategy, SKAN/iOS privacy-aware execution, and incrementality testing; B2C experience required, fintech or crypto preferred.

jobs.excerpt:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. 
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Marketing at Brex 
 The Marketing team tells the Brex story, determines messaging and positioning, and translates our products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our marketers, across Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, are responsible for acquiring new customers and have a deep understanding of the business. We're a highly cross-functional team and partner most closely with Product, Sales, and Business Development to show our prospects and customers how we can help them reach their full potential. 
 What you'll do 
 As an Event Marketing Manager at Brex, you’ll support a portfolio of B2B events - the events that put us in front of founders, finance leaders, and operators. You'll report to the Head of Events on the Corporate Events team in Revenue Marketing, and work daily with sales, field marketing, and brand design. Corporate Events is a growing team that delivers highly engaging, high quality events with consistent ROI. You'll deliver a portfolio of industry & hosted events from brief through post-event reporting. You'll have input on the portfolio strategy and how the team operates. The work spans strategy, operations, experience design with our brand and creative teams, and tight coordination with sales on what happens before and after each event.  
   Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in one of our 5 hubs (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Salt Lake City and Vancouver). We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work! 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Own how Brex shows up at each event in your portfolio, from brief through post-event reporting, including vendor management, design partnership, registration, on-site execution, and sales follow-up 
 Execute event sponsorships end-to-end: vendor and venue coordination, logistics, onsite management, and post-event reporting 
 Coordinate with sales on pre- and post-event outreach - managing specific tasks and timelines to ensure lead follow-through and maximize pipeline impact 
 Partner with design and brand marketing on activations, merch, and graphics for each event 
 Manage vendor contracts and event budgets end-to-end, including reconciliation and variance flagging 
 Collaborate with sales and field marketing teams to develop booth experiences and promotional materials aligned to brand standards 
 Own lead gen & pipeline targets; understand how event performance connects to broader marketing and sales goals 
 Improve repeatable tradeshow processes, documentation, and workflows that scale across the portfolio 
 Evaluate and recommend new event opportunities based on audience fit and pipeline potential 
 Travel to manage onsite components for assigned events, as well as supporting events across the team as needed 
 
 Requirements 
 
 3+ years of experience in event marketing or field marketing, with hands-on tradeshow and conference execution experience 
 Demonstrated ability to own events end-to-end: logistics, vendors, onsite execution, and the follow-through that happens after everyone goes home 
 Strong project management skills and a structured approach to planning; experience with project management tools is a plus 
 Known for cross-functional collaboration and clean handoffs and proactive communication at all levels 
 Understands how events connect to business goals - you know why you're running an event and what success looks like 
 Team-oriented but self-directed: you collaborate closely and communicate openly, and you own your workstream without waiting to be told what to do next 
 Comfortable using AI tools to streamline planning, communications, and repeatable workflows 
 Proficiency with G Suite; familiarity with Monday.com, Salesforce, Marketo, or Nooks is a plus 
 Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% for onsite event setup, supervision, and management 
 A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, related field, or equivalent professional experience 
 
 Nice to haves 
 
 Experience managing executive engagements and  hospitality suites 
 Experience managing event content and speaking engagements 
 Familiarity with ClaudeAI and Splash 
 Knowledge of the fintech or B2B SaaS industry 
 CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) or similar certification 
 
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $103,960 - $129,950. However, the starting base pay will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package. 
   Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a  brex.com  domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: GTM Specialist, Service Specialist Orgnization
jobs.excerpt:
Overview Would you like to be the person in Seattle who makes sure the demands and the potential of CMHK customers are heard, understood, and acted on by the teams that build the products? As a Go-to-Market Specialist (GTMS) based in the US, you sit close to AWS service teams and global stakeholders, and you use that proximity to carry the reality of the China Mainland & Hong Kong market into the rooms where product and service decisions are made. You are equal parts specialist and advocate: you understand the technology deeply, you translate CMHK customer needs into a compelling case, and you influence and convince the key people who can act on it. This role is built for someone who is genuinely self-driven and accountable for outcomes. Success is not measured by activity — it is measured by results: the roadmap asks you land, the stakeholders you move, the pipeline you create, and the adoption you drive. You will operate at high intensity, hold multiple engagements at once, and keep pace with a fast-moving cloud market. You are comfortable under pressure, you take ownership without waiting to be told, and you have the personal presence and communication skills to earn trust quickly with both service-team leaders and customers. Above all, you are someone who pushes: you do not simply flag a problem, you drive the specific action that resolves it. The ideal candidate combines credible technical understanding of cloud, infrastructure, and managed services with strong business instincts and communication. You should be able to hold your own with a service-team engineer on the technical substance and, in the same afternoon, frame a crisp, data-backed argument that convinces a product leader to prioritize a CMHK customer requirement. A strong sense of ownership, a bias for action, and the ability to deliver results in ambiguity are essential. What Makes This Role Different Beyond the standard specialist mandate, we are hiring against four differentiating capabilities. Candidates will be assessed explicitly against each. 1. Real technical understanding of cloud, infrastructure, and managed services You bring a strong understanding of the cloud business — not just what a service does, but how cloud infrastructure and managed services fit together commercially and technically, where the boundaries and trade-offs are, and when a given approach is the right one for a customer. Ideally you also have a working understanding of accelerated computing and GPU-carried workloads (training or inference) and the infrastructure choices they drive. You hold a defensible technical opinion in front of both a customer architect and an AWS service team. 2. Presence, affinity, and communication that earns trust fast You build rapport quickly and are easy to work with under pressure. Your written and verbal communication is clear, concise, and persuasive, whether you are in front of a service GM, a product leader, or a customer executive. People trust you with their decisions because you are credible and you follow through. 3. Self-driven ownership and accountability for results You do not wait to be assigned work — you see what needs to happen and you own it. You set your own agenda against the outcomes that matter, you operate independently at high intensity, and you hold yourself accountable for the result, not just the effort. When something is ambiguous, you make a call and move. 4. The ability to influence and push things to happen This is the core operating trait of the role. You diagnose why a customer need is not landing with a service team, you build the case, and then you drive the relevant people — internal and external — to act on it. You escalate when you should, you disagree and commit when you must, and you do not let important things quietly stall. Key job responsibilities Voice of the Region to Service & Global Stakeholders Based in Seattle near AWS service teams; act as the bridge carrying CMHK customer reality into product and service decisions. Represent CMHK demands, use cases, and blockers persuasively to GMs and global leaders; make the investment case. Influence decision-makers to prioritize CMHK needs—converting field signal into roadmap action and closing the loop back to the region. Go-to-Market Execution & Field Guidance Own the GTM motion for the infrastructure and managed-services portfolio, from narrative to execution. Build pipeline by engaging customers, partners, and account teams with a differentiated value proposition. Guide account teams on live deals: qualify, shape technical approach, unblock obstacles, and know when to escalate vs. coach. Technical Depth & Field Enablement Maintain credible expertise across compute, storage, networking, and managed services as a go-to field resource. Prove a repeatable motion on a real win, codify it, and scale it across the field. Communication & Data-Driven Management Deliver crisp, data-backed updates on pipeline, adoption, competition, and roadblocks. Leverage Salesforce and internal systems to track pipeline and build the investment case.

Basic qualifications:
- 7+ years of technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services experience - Demonstrable understanding of cloud, infrastructure, and managed services — you can speak credibly to how they are architected and where the trade-offs lie. - A track record of self-driven ownership and delivering measurable results, including examples of independently driving outcomes under pressure and ambiguity. - Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders who are not in your reporting line — building a case, changing minds, and driving the relevant people to act. - Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the personal affinity and presence to engage credibly with both senior leaders and hands-on technical practitioners. - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:
- Hands-on or architecture-level experience with cloud platforms, infrastructure, and managed services; working knowledge of software development practices, data center, and networking technologies. - Experience working across a global, matrixed organization and influencing HQ service and product teams from an in-region or bridging role. - Familiarity with the CMHK / Greater China market and its customer segments, or comparable experience representing a region's needs to a global product organization. - Familiarity with AI/ML and generative AI infrastructure requirements, and how infrastructure and managed-services decisions constrain or enable them. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Group Product Marketing Manager on the Base Marketing team, you'll drive the GTM strategy and operations that generate demand and build trust for Base across developers, builders, and enterprises. This team is responsible for positioning Base as the leading Layer 2 for bringing the world onchain. You'll operate as a player-coach, owning high-priority launches and events while managing a small team of PMMs and running the operating rhythm that keeps the team shipping high-quality work on time. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Own GTM strategy and execution for priority products and audiences, including positioning, messaging, and launch planning that drives measurable adoption. 
 Lead cross-functional launches with Product, BD, CDP, DevRel, Comms, Legal, and Compliance, translating complex technical capabilities into clear narratives that resonate with developers and builders. 
 Drive marketing operations for the team, including planning, prioritization, process design, and the operating cadence that keeps a fast-moving team delivering on time. 
 Manage a team of up to 2 PMMs in a player-coach capacity, setting quality standards for storytelling and GTM execution while personally owning key workstreams. 
 Shape Base's global events strategy and deliver end-to-end event presence, from flagship conferences to owned activations including Base Batches. 
 Define and report on launch performance, adoption, pipeline influence, and partner amplification metrics, optimizing against them to inform ongoing strategy. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 
 8+ years in product marketing or GTM roles, including direct experience leading and managing a marketing team with measurable adoption or revenue outcomes. 
 Track record of owning end-to-end GTM launches from strategy through execution, with demonstrated results in driving product adoption or pipeline growth. 
 Proven experience running marketing operations and/or events at scale, delivering both the daily operating rhythm and high-visibility moments. 
 Exceptional writing and storytelling ability with a demonstrated track record of distilling complex, technical concepts into compelling narratives for developer and builder audiences. 
 Fluency with how onchain products work (payments, stablecoins, tokenization, custody) and demonstrated comfort partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams.
